<div id="toast" class="toast"></div>


<script>

const API =
    "http://localhost:5000/api/appointments";

const PATIENT_API =
    "http://localhost:5000/api/saas/patients";

const HOSPITAL_ID =
    "HOSP-TEST-001";


let appointments = [];
let selectedAppointment = null;
let medicines = [];


/* =========================
   HELPERS
========================= */

function escapeHTML(value){

    return String(value ?? "")
        .replace(/&/g,"&amp;")
        .replace(/</g,"&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g,"&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g,"&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g,"&#039;");

}


function money(value){

    return "₹" +
        Number(value || 0)
        .toLocaleString("en-IN");

}


function toast(message,type=""){

    const box =
        document.getElementById("toast");

    box.textContent = message;

    box.className =
        "toast show " +
        (type === "success"
            ? "success"
            : type === "error"
                ? "error-toast"
                : "");

    setTimeout(() => {

        box.classList.remove("show");

    },3000);

}


function statusClass(status){

    const value =
        String(status || "")
        .toLowerCase();

    if(value === "scheduled")
        return "status-scheduled";

    if(value === "confirmed")
        return "status-confirmed";

    if(value === "waiting")
        return "status-waiting";

    if(value.includes("consultation"))
        return "status-consultation";

    if(value === "completed")
        return "status-completed";

    if(value === "cancelled")
        return "status-cancelled";

    if(value === "no show")
        return "status-no-show";

    return "status-scheduled";

}


/* =========================
   LOAD APPOINTMENTS
========================= */

async function loadAppointments(){

    const list =
        document.getElementById(
            "appointmentList"
        );

    list.innerHTML =
        `<div class="loading">
            Loading appointments...
        </div>`;

    try{

        const response =
            await fetch(
                `${API}?hospitalId=${encodeURIComponent(HOSPITAL_ID)}`
            );

        if(!response.ok){

            throw new Error(
                "Appointment API failed"
            );

        }

        const data =
            await response.json();

        appointments =
            data.appointments ||
            data.data ||
            [];

        renderAppointments();

        /*
         * Automatically select the first
         * appointment if nothing is selected.
         */
        if(
            !selectedAppointment &&
            appointments.length
        ){

            await selectAppointment(
                appointments[0].id
            );

        }

    }catch(error){

        console.error(error);

        list.innerHTML =
            `<div class="error">
                Unable to load appointments.
            </div>`;

        toast(
            "Appointments load nahi ho paaye.",
            "error"
        );

    }

}


/* =========================
   RENDER APPOINTMENTS
========================= */

function renderAppointments(){

    const list =
        document.getElementById(
            "appointmentList"
        );

    if(!appointments.length){

        list.innerHTML =
            `<div class="empty">
                No appointments found.
            </div>`;

        return;

    }


    list.innerHTML =
        appointments.map(item => {

            const active =
                selectedAppointment &&
                selectedAppointment.id === item.id
                    ? "active"
                    : "";

            return `
                <div
                    class="appointment ${active}"
                    onclick="selectAppointment('${escapeHTML(item.id)}')">

                    <div class="ap-top">

                        <div class="ap-name">
                            ${escapeHTML(
                                item.patientName ||
                                "Unknown Patient"
                            )}
                        </div>

                        <div class="status ${statusClass(item.status)}">
                            ${escapeHTML(
                                item.status ||
                                "Scheduled"
                            )}
                        </div>

                    </div>

                    <div class="ap-info">

                        ${escapeHTML(
                            item.date || "—"
                        )}
                        •
                        ${escapeHTML(
                            item.time || "—"
                        )}

                        <br>

                        ${escapeHTML(
                            item.doctorName ||
                            "Doctor not assigned"
                        )}

                        <br>

                        ${escapeHTML(
                            item.department ||
                            "Department not specified"
                        )}

                    </div>

                </div>
            `;

        }).join("");

}


/* =========================
   SELECT APPOINTMENT
========================= */

async function selectAppointment(id){

    try{

        const response =
            await fetch(
                `${API}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}?hospitalId=${encodeURIComponent(HOSPITAL_ID)}`
            );

        if(!response.ok){

            throw new Error(
                "Appointment detail failed"
            );

        }

        const data =
            await response.json();

        selectedAppointment =
            data.appointment ||
            data.data ||
            data;

        renderAppointments();

        await loadPatient();

        fillAppointment();

        /*
         * Move appointment into consultation
         * when doctor opens it.
         */
        if(
            selectedAppointment.status === "Scheduled" ||
            selectedAppointment.status === "Confirmed" ||
            selectedAppointment.status === "Waiting"
        ){

            await updateAppointmentStatus(
                "In Consultation",
                false
            );

        }

    }catch(error){

        console.error(error);

        toast(
            "Appointment details load nahi ho paaye.",
            "error"
        );

    }

}


/* =========================
   PATIENT
========================= */

async function loadPatient(){

    if(!selectedAppointment){

        return;

    }

    const patientId =
        selectedAppointment.patientId;

    if(!patientId){

        fillPatientFallback();

        return;

    }


    try{

        const response =
            await fetch(
                `${PATIENT_API}/${encodeURIComponent(patientId)}?hospitalId=${encodeURIComponent(HOSPITAL_ID)}`
            );

        if(!response.ok){

            throw new Error(
                "Patient API failed"
            );

        }

        const data =
            await response.json();

        const patient =
            data.patient ||
            data.data ||
            data;

        fillPatient(patient);

    }catch(error){

        console.error(error);

        fillPatientFallback();

    }

}


function fillPatient(patient){

    const name =
        patient.name ||
        `${patient.firstName || ""} ${patient.lastName || ""}`.trim() ||
        selectedAppointment.patientName ||
        "Patient";

    document.getElementById(
        "patientName"
    ).textContent =
        name;

    document.getElementById(
        "patientId"
    ).textContent =
        `UHID: ${patient.uhid || patient.id || selectedAppointment.patientId || "—"}`;

    document.getElementById(
        "patientAge"
    ).textContent =
        patient.age ||
        calculateAge(patient.dateOfBirth) ||
        "—";

    document.getElementById(
        "patientGender"
    ).textContent =
        patient.gender || "—";

    document.getElementById(
        "patientBlood"
    ).textContent =
        patient.bloodGroup || "—";

    document.getElementById(
        "patientPhone"
    ).textContent =
        patient.phone ||
        selectedAppointment.patientPhone ||
        "—";

    document.getElementById(
        "patientAvatar"
    ).textContent =
        name.charAt(0).toUpperCase();

}


function fillPatientFallback(){

    const name =
        selectedAppointment?.patientName ||
        "Patient";

    document.getElementById(
        "patientName"
    ).textContent =
        name;

    document.getElementById(
        "patientId"
    ).textContent =
        `Patient ID: ${selectedAppointment?.patientId || "—"}`;

    document.getElementById(
        "patientAge"
    ).textContent =
        "—";

    document.getElementById(
        "patientGender"
    ).textContent =
        "—";

    document.getElementById(
        "patientBlood"
    ).textContent =
        "—";

    document.getElementById(
        "patientPhone"
    ).textContent =
        selectedAppointment?.patientPhone || "—";

    document.getElementById(
        "patientAvatar"
    ).textContent =
        name.charAt(0).toUpperCase();

}


function calculateAge(date){

    if(!date) return "";

    const birth =
        new Date(date);

    if(Number.isNaN(birth.getTime()))
        return "";

    const today =
        new Date();

    let age =
        today.getFullYear() -
        birth.getFullYear();

    const month =
        today.getMonth() -
        birth.getMonth();

    if(
        month < 0 ||
        (
            month === 0 &&
            today.getDate() < birth.getDate()
        )
    ){

        age--;

    }

    return age > 0 ? age : "";

}


/* =========================
   APPOINTMENT DETAILS
========================= */

function fillAppointment(){

    if(!selectedAppointment)
        return;


    const a =
        selectedAppointment;


    document.getElementById(
        "selectedId"
    ).textContent =
        a.id || "—";

    document.getElementById(
        "selectedDoctor"
    ).textContent =
        a.doctorName || "—";

    document.getElementById(
        "selectedDepartment"
    ).textContent =
        a.department || "—";

    document.getElementById(
        "selectedDate"
    ).textContent =
        a.date || "—";

    document.getElementById(
        "selectedTime"
    ).textContent =
        a.time || "—";

    document.getElementById(
        "selectedType"
    ).textContent =
        a.type || "OPD";

    document.getElementById(
        "selectedReason"
    ).textContent =
        a.reason || "—";

    document.getElementById(
        "selectedFee"
    ).textContent =
        money(a.fee);

}


/* =========================
   MEDICINES
========================= */

function addMedicine(){

    medicines.push({

        name:"",
        dosage:"",
        duration:""

    });

    renderMedicines();

}


function removeMedicine(index){

    medicines.splice(index,1);

    renderMedicines();

}


function updateMedicine(
    index,
    field,
    value
){

    if(!medicines[index])
        return;

    medicines[index][field] =
        value;

}


function renderMedicines(){

    const list =
        document.getElementById(
            "medicineList"
        );

    const empty =
        document.getElementById(
            "medicineEmpty"
        );


    if(!medicines.length){

        list.innerHTML = "";

        empty.style.display =
            "block";

        return;

    }


    empty.style.display =
        "none";


    list.innerHTML =
        medicines.map(
            (medicine,index) => {

                return `
                    <div class="medicine-row">

                        <input
                            type="text"
                            placeholder="Medicine name"
                            value="${escapeHTML(medicine.name)}"
                            oninput="updateMedicine(${index},'name',this.value)">

                        <input
                            type="text"
                            placeholder="Dosage"
                            value="${escapeHTML(medicine.dosage)}"
                            oninput="updateMedicine(${index},'dosage',this.value)">

                        <input
                            type="text"
                            placeholder="Duration"
                            value="${escapeHTML(medicine.duration)}"
                            oninput="updateMedicine(${index},'duration',this.value)">

                        <button
                            type="button"
                            class="remove-med"
                            onclick="removeMedicine(${index})">
                            ×
                        </button>

                    </div>
                `;

            }
        ).join("");

}


/* =========================
   COLLECT FORM
========================= */

function collectConsultation(){

    const selectedLabs =
        Array.from(
            document.querySelectorAll(
                ".lab-check:checked"
            )
        ).map(
            checkbox =>
                checkbox.value
        );


    const symptomsText =
        document.getElementById(
            "symptoms"
        ).value.trim();


    const symptoms =
        symptomsText
            ? symptomsText
                .split(",")
                .map(item => item.trim())
                .filter(Boolean)
            : [];


    return {

        diagnosis:
            document.getElementById(
                "diagnosis"
            ).value.trim(),

        symptoms,

        vitals:{

            temperature:
                document.getElementById(
                    "temperature"
                ).value.trim(),

            bloodPressure:
                document.getElementById(
                    "bloodPressure"
                ).value.trim(),

            pulse:
                document.getElementById(
                    "pulse"
                ).value.trim(),

            spo2:
                document.getElementById(
                    "spo2"
                ).value.trim(),

            weight:
                document.getElementById(
                    "weight"
                ).value.trim(),

            height:
                document.getElementById(
                    "height"
                ).value.trim()

        },

        notes:
            document.getElementById(
                "notes"
            ).value.trim(),

        followUpDate:
            document.getElementById(
                "followUpDate"
            ).value || null,

        prescription:{
            medicines:
                medicines.filter(
                    medicine =>
                        medicine.name.trim()
                )
        },

        labOrder:{
            tests:selectedLabs
        }

    };

}


/* =========================
   SAVE CONSULTATION
========================= */

async function saveConsultation(
    completeAfterSave=false
){

    if(!selectedAppointment){

        toast(
            "Pehle appointment select karo.",
            "error"
        );

        return;

    }


    const consultation =
        collectConsultation();


    if(!consultation.diagnosis){

        toast(
            "Diagnosis enter karo.",
            "error"
        );

        return;

    }


    try{

        const response =
            await fetch(
                `${API}/${encodeURIComponent(selectedAppointment.id)}/diagnosis?hospitalId=${encodeURIComponent(HOSPITAL_ID)}`,
                {
                    method:"PATCH",

                    headers:{
                        "Content-Type":
                            "application/json"
                    },

                    body:JSON.stringify(
                        consultation
                    )
                }
            );


        const data =
            await response.json();


        if(!response.ok){

            throw new Error(
                data.message ||
                "Consultation save failed"
            );

        }


        selectedAppointment =
            data.appointment ||
            data.data ||
            selectedAppointment;


        toast(
            completeAfterSave
                ? "Consultation saved successfully."
                : "Consultation saved.",
            "success"
        );


        if(completeAfterSave){

            await updateAppointmentStatus(
                "Completed",
                true
            );

        }

    }catch(error){

        console.error(error);

        toast(
            error.message ||
            "Consultation save nahi ho paayi.",
            "error"
        );

    }

}


/* =========================
   STATUS UPDATE
========================= */

async function updateAppointmentStatus(
    status,
    showToast=true
){

    if(!selectedAppointment)
        return;


    try{

        const response =
            await fetch(
                `${API}/${encodeURIComponent(selectedAppointment.id)}/status?hospitalId=${encodeURIComponent(HOSPITAL_ID)}`,
                {
                    method:"PATCH",

                    headers:{
                        "Content-Type":
                            "application/json"
                    },

                    body:JSON.stringify({
                        status
                    })
                }
            );


        const data =
            await response.json();


        if(!response.ok){

            throw new Error(
                data.message ||
                "Status update failed"
            );

        }


        selectedAppointment =
            data.appointment ||
            data.data ||
            selectedAppointment;


        /*
         * Update local appointment
         * so UI immediately changes.
         */

        const index =
            appointments.findIndex(
                item =>
                    item.id ===
                    selectedAppointment.id
            );


        if(index !== -1){

            appointments[index] =
                selectedAppointment;

        }


        renderAppointments();


        if(showToast){

            toast(
                `Appointment marked as ${status}.`,
                "success"
            );

        }

    }catch(error){

        console.error(error);

        if(showToast){

            toast(
                error.message ||
                "Status update nahi hua.",
                "error"
            );

        }

    }

}


/* =========================
   COMPLETE
========================= */

async function completeConsultation(){

    if(!selectedAppointment){

        toast(
            "Pehle appointment select karo.",
            "error"
        );

        return;

    }


    const diagnosis =
        document.getElementById(
            "diagnosis"
        ).value.trim();


    if(!diagnosis){

        toast(
            "Diagnosis enter karna zaroori hai.",
            "error"
        );

        return;

    }


    await saveConsultation(
        true
    );

}


/* =========================
   RESET FORM
========================= */

function resetForm(){

    document.getElementById(
        "temperature"
    ).value = "";

    document.getElementById(
        "bloodPressure"
    ).value = "";

    document.getElementById(
        "pulse"
    ).value = "";

    document.getElementById(
        "spo2"
    ).value = "";

    document.getElementById(
        "weight"
    ).value = "";

    document.getElementById(
        "height"
    ).value = "";

    document.getElementById(
        "symptoms"
    ).value = "";

    document.getElementById(
        "diagnosis"
    ).value = "";

    document.getElementById(
        "notes"
    ).value = "";

    document.getElementById(
        "followUpDate"
    ).value = "";

    medicines = [];

    renderMedicines();

    document
        .querySelectorAll(
            ".lab-check"
        )
        .forEach(
            checkbox =>
                checkbox.checked = false
        );

}


/* =========================
   INIT
========================= */

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    () => {

        /*
         * Don't auto-reset because
         * selected appointment may be
         * opened from another page later.
         */

        renderMedicines();

        loadAppointments();

    }
);

</script>

</body>
</html>

<script>

const API =
    "http://localhost:5000/api/saas/patients";

const HOSPITAL_ID =
    "HOSP-TEST-001";

let patients = [];

/* ================= HELPERS ================= */

function $(id){
    return document.getElementById(id);
}

function escapeHTML(value){
    return String(value ?? "")
        .replace(/&/g,"&amp;")
        .replace(/</g,"&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g,"&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g,"&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g,"&#039;");
}

function initials(name){
    return String(name || "P")
        .trim()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .slice(0,2)
        .map(x => x[0])
        .join("")
        .toUpperCase();
}

function toast(message,type="success"){

    const box = $("toast");

    box.textContent = message;

    box.className =
        "toast show " + type;

    setTimeout(() => {
        box.className = "toast";
    },3000);
}

/* ================= LOAD STATS ================= */

async function loadStats(){

    try{

        const response =
            await fetch(
                `${API}/stats?hospitalId=${HOSPITAL_ID}`
            );

        const data =
            await response.json();

        if(!data.success) return;

        const s = data.stats;

        $("totalPatients").textContent =
            s.total ?? 0;

        $("activePatients").textContent =
            s.active ?? 0;

        $("todayRegistrations").textContent =
            s.todayRegistrations ?? 0;

        $("genderStats").textContent =
            `${s.male ?? 0} / ${s.female ?? 0}`;

    }catch(error){

        console.error(
            "Patient stats error:",
            error
        );

    }
}

/* ================= LOAD PATIENTS ================= */

let searchTimer;

async function loadPatients(){

    clearTimeout(searchTimer);

    searchTimer = setTimeout(
        async () => {

            try{

                const search =
                    encodeURIComponent(
                        $("searchInput").value.trim()
                    );

                const status =
                    encodeURIComponent(
                        $("statusFilter").value
                    );

                const gender =
                    encodeURIComponent(
                        $("genderFilter").value
                    );

                const bloodGroup =
                    encodeURIComponent(
                        $("bloodFilter").value
                    );

                const url =
                    `${API}?hospitalId=${HOSPITAL_ID}` +
                    `&search=${search}` +
                    `&status=${status}` +
                    `&gender=${gender}` +
                    `&bloodGroup=${bloodGroup}`;

                const response =
                    await fetch(url);

                const data =
                    await response.json();

                if(!data.success){

                    toast(
                        data.message ||
                        "Unable to load patients",
                        "error"
                    );

                    return;
                }

                patients =
                    data.patients || [];

                renderPatients();

            }catch(error){

                console.error(error);

                toast(
                    "Patient API unavailable",
                    "error"
                );

            }

        },
        250
    );
}

/* ================= RENDER TABLE ================= */

function renderPatients(){

    const body =
        $("patientTableBody");

    if(!patients.length){

        body.innerHTML = `
            <tr>
                <td colspan="7">
                    <div class="empty">
                        <div class="empty-icon">👥</div>
                        <strong>No patients found</strong>
                        <p>
                            Register a new patient or change your filters.
                        </p>
                    </div>
                </td>
            </tr>
        `;

        return;
    }

    body.innerHTML =
        patients.map(patient => {

            const address =
                patient.address || {};

            const status =
                String(
                    patient.status || "active"
                ).toLowerCase();

            return `
                <tr>

                    <td>

                        <div class="patient-cell">

                            <div class="patient-mini">
                                ${escapeHTML(
                                    initials(patient.name)
                                )}
                            </div>

                            <div>

                                <div class="patient-name">
                                    ${escapeHTML(
                                        patient.name
                                    )}
                                </div>

                                <div class="patient-uhid">
                                    ${escapeHTML(
                                        patient.patientId
                                    )}
                                </div>

                            </div>

                        </div>

                    </td>

                    <td>
                        <strong>
                            ${escapeHTML(
                                patient.uhid
                            )}
                        </strong>
                    </td>

                    <td>
                        <div>
                            ${escapeHTML(
                                patient.phone
                            )}
                        </div>

                        <div style="color:#94a3b8;font-size:10px">
                            ${escapeHTML(
                                patient.email || ""
                            )}
                        </div>
                    </td>

                    <td>
                        ${escapeHTML(
                            patient.age ?? "—"
                        )}
                        /
                        ${escapeHTML(
                            patient.gender || "—"
                        )}
                    </td>

                    <td>
                        <span class="blood">
                            ${escapeHTML(
                                patient.bloodGroup || "—"
                            )}
                        </span>
                    </td>

                    <td>

                        <span class="
                            badge
                            ${
                                status === "active"
                                ? "badge-active"
                                : "badge-inactive"
                            }
                        ">
                            ${escapeHTML(status)}
                        </span>

                    </td>

                    <td>

                        <div class="actions">

                            <button
                                class="icon-btn"
                                title="View Patient"
                                onclick="openProfile('${escapeHTML(
                                    patient.id
                                )}')">
                                👁️
                            </button>

                            <button
                                class="icon-btn"
                                title="Archive Patient"
                                onclick="archivePatient('${escapeHTML(
                                    patient.id
                                )}')">
                                🗃️
                            </button>

                        </div>

                    </td>

                </tr>
            `;

        }).join("");
}

/* ================= MODAL ================= */

function openPatientModal(){

    $("patientModal")
        .classList.add("show");

    $("patientName").focus();
}

function closePatientModal(){

    $("patientModal")
        .classList.remove("show");

    $("patientForm").reset();

    $("patientState").value =
        "Uttar Pradesh";
}

/* ================= REGISTER ================= */

$("patientForm")
    .addEventListener(
        "submit",
        async function(event){

            event.preventDefault();

            const button =
                $("registerBtn");

            button.disabled = true;
            button.textContent =
                "Registering...";

            try{

                const allergies =
                    $("patientAllergies")
                        .value
                        .split(",")
                        .map(x => x.trim())
                        .filter(Boolean);

                const conditions =
                    $("patientConditions")
                        .value
                        .split(",")
                        .map(x => x.trim())
                        .filter(Boolean);

                const medicines =
                    $("patientMedicines")
                        .value
                        .split(",")
                        .map(x => x.trim())
                        .filter(Boolean);

                const history =
                    $("patientHistory")
                        .value
                        .trim();

                const body = {

                    hospitalId:
                        HOSPITAL_ID,

                    name:
                        $("patientName")
                            .value
                            .trim(),

                    phone:
                        $("patientPhone")
                            .value
                            .trim(),

                    email:
                        $("patientEmail")
                            .value
                            .trim(),

                    dateOfBirth:
                        $("patientDob")
                            .value,

                    gender:
                        $("patientGender")
                            .value,

                    bloodGroup:
                        $("patientBlood")
                            .value,

                    maritalStatus:
                        $("patientMarital")
                            .value,

                    address:{

                        line1:
                            $("patientAddress")
                                .value
                                .trim(),

                        city:
                            $("patientCity")
                                .value
                                .trim(),

                        state:
                            $("patientState")
                                .value
                                .trim(),

                        pincode:
                            $("patientPincode")
                                .value
                                .trim(),

                        country:
                            "India"

                    },

                    emergencyContact:{

                        name:
                            $("emergencyName")
                                .value
                                .trim(),

                        relationship:
                            $("emergencyRelation")
                                .value
                                .trim(),

                        phone:
                            $("emergencyPhone")
                                .value
                                .trim()

                    },

                    allergies,

                    chronicConditions:
                        conditions,

                    currentMedications:
                        medicines,

                    medicalHistory:
                        history
                            ? [history]
                            : [],

                    notes:
                        $("patientNotes")
                            .value
                            .trim(),

                    tags:[
                        "New Patient"
                    ],

                    documents:[],

                    insurance:{
                        provider:"",
                        policyNumber:"",
                        validTill:""
                    },

                    portalEnabled:true,

                    status:"active"

                };

                const response =
                    await fetch(
                        API,
                        {
                            method:"POST",

                            headers:{
                                "Content-Type":
                                    "application/json"
                            },

                            body:
                                JSON.stringify(body)
                        }
                    );

                const data =
                    await response.json();

                if(!response.ok ||
                   !data.success){

                    throw new Error(
                        data.message ||
                        "Patient registration failed"
                    );
                }

                toast(
                    `Patient registered — ${data.patient.uhid}`,
                    "success"
                );

                closePatientModal();

                await loadStats();
                await loadPatients();

            }catch(error){

                console.error(error);

                toast(
                    error.message ||
                    "Registration failed",
                    "error"
                );

            }finally{

                button.disabled = false;

                button.textContent =
                    "Register Patient";

            }

        }
    );

/* ================= PROFILE ================= */

async function openProfile(id){

    try{

        const response =
            await fetch(
                `${API}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}` +
                `?hospitalId=${HOSPITAL_ID}`
            );

        const data =
            await response.json();

        if(!data.success){

            toast(
                data.message ||
                "Patient not found",
                "error"
            );

            return;
        }

        const patient =
            data.patient;

        $("profileAvatar")
            .textContent =
            initials(patient.name);

        $("profileName")
            .textContent =
            patient.name || "Patient";

        $("profileUhid")
            .textContent =
            `${patient.uhid || "—"} • ${patient.status || "active"}`;

        $("profileId")
            .textContent =
            patient.patientId || "—";

        $("profileGender")
            .textContent =
            patient.gender || "—";

        $("profileAge")
            .textContent =
            patient.age ?? "—";

        $("profileBlood")
            .textContent =
            patient.bloodGroup || "—";

        $("profilePhone")
            .textContent =
            patient.phone || "—";

        $("profileEmail")
            .textContent =
            patient.email || "—";

        const stats =
            patient.stats || {};

        $("visitCount")
            .textContent =
            stats.totalVisits || 0;

        $("appointmentCount")
            .textContent =
            stats.totalAppointments || 0;

        $("admissionCount")
            .textContent =
            stats.totalAdmissions || 0;

        $("billCount")
            .textContent =
            stats.totalBills || 0;

        $("labCount")
            .textContent =
            stats.totalLabOrders || 0;

        $("prescriptionCount")
            .textContent =
            stats.totalPrescriptions || 0;

        const emergency =
            patient.emergencyContact || {};

        $("profileEmergencyName")
            .textContent =
            emergency.name || "—";

        $("profileEmergencyRelation")
            .textContent =
            emergency.relationship ||
            emergency.relation ||
            "—";

        $("profileEmergencyPhone")
            .textContent =
            emergency.phone || "—";

        renderTags(
            "profileAllergies",
            patient.allergies || [],
            "alert-tag"
        );

        renderTags(
            "profileConditions",
            patient.chronicConditions || []
        );

        $("profileHistory")
            .textContent =
            (patient.medicalHistory || []).join(", ") ||
            "No medical history recorded.";

        $("profileNotes")
            .textContent =
            patient.notes ||
            "No notes.";

        $("profileDrawer")
            .classList.add("show");

    }catch(error){

        console.error(error);

        toast(
            "Unable to load patient profile",
            "error"
        );

    }
}

function renderTags(id,items,extraClass=""){

    const box = $(id);

    if(!items.length){

        box.innerHTML =
            `<span style="color:#94a3b8;font-size:11px">
                None recorded
            </span>`;

        return;
    }

    box.innerHTML =
        items.map(item => `
            <span class="tag ${extraClass}">
                ${escapeHTML(item)}
            </span>
        `).join("");
}

function closeProfile(){

    $("profileDrawer")
        .classList.remove("show");
}

/* ================= ARCHIVE ================= */

async function archivePatient(id){

    const patient =
        patients.find(
            p => p.id === id
        );

    if(!patient) return;

    const confirmed =
        confirm(
            `Archive patient "${patient.name}"?`
        );

    if(!confirmed) return;

    try{

        const response =
            await fetch(
                `${API}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}` +
                `?hospitalId=${HOSPITAL_ID}`,
                {
                    method:"DELETE"
                }
            );

        const data =
            await response.json();

        if(!response.ok ||
           !data.success){

            throw new Error(
                data.message ||
                "Unable to archive patient"
            );
        }

        toast(
            "Patient archived successfully",
            "success"
        );

        await loadStats();
        await loadPatients();

    }catch(error){

        console.error(error);

        toast(
            error.message ||
            "Archive failed",
            "error"
        );

    }
}

/* ================= CLOSE ON BACKDROP ================= */

$("patientModal")
    .addEventListener(
        "click",
        event => {

            if(
                event.target ===
                $("patientModal")
            ){
                closePatientModal();
            }

        }
    );

/* ================= INITIAL LOAD ================= */

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    async () => {

        await loadStats();
        await loadPatients();

    }
);

</script>

<script>
const token = localStorage.getItem("gjh_token");

let currentUser = null;
let appointments = [];
let currentAppointment = null;

function authHeaders(){
  return {
    "Content-Type":"application/json",
    "Authorization":"Bearer " + token
  };
}

function escapeHtml(value){
  return String(value ?? "")
    .replaceAll("&","&amp;")
    .replaceAll("<","&lt;")
    .replaceAll(">","&gt;")
    .replaceAll('"',"&quot;")
    .replaceAll("'","&#039;");
}

function dateOnly(value){
  return String(value || "").slice(0,10);
}

function todayString(){
  const d = new Date();
  const y = d.getFullYear();
  const m = String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0");
  const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,"0");
  return `${y}-${m}-${day}`;
}

function statusClass(status){
  return String(status || "")
    .toLowerCase()
    .replaceAll(" ","");
}

function showToast(message){
  const t = document.getElementById("toast");
  t.textContent = message;
  t.classList.add("show");
  setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove("show"),2500);
}

async function verifyDoctor(){

  if(!token){
    window.location.href="login.html";
    return;
  }

  try{

    const res = await fetch("/api/private/doctor",{
      headers:authHeaders()
    });

    const data = await res.json();

    if(!res.ok || !data.success){
      localStorage.removeItem("gjh_token");
      localStorage.removeItem("gjh_user");
      window.location.href="login.html";
      return;
    }

    currentUser = data.user;

    document.getElementById("doctorName").textContent =
      currentUser.name || currentUser.username || "Doctor";

    const name = currentUser.name || "Doctor";
    document.getElementById("avatar").textContent =
      name.split(" ").map(x=>x[0]).join("").slice(0,2).toUpperCase();

    await loadAppointments();

  }catch(error){

    showToast("Unable to connect with server");

  }
}

async function loadAppointments(){

  try{

    const res = await fetch("/api/appointments",{
      headers:authHeaders()
    });

    const data = await res.json();

    if(!res.ok){
      throw new Error(data.message || "Failed");
    }

    appointments = Array.isArray(data)
      ? data
      : (data.appointments || []);

    updateStats();
    renderToday();
    renderAppointments();
    populateSelects();
    renderFollowups();

  }catch(error){

    console.error(error);
    showToast("Appointments load failed");

  }
}

function updateStats(){

  const today = appointments.filter(
    a => dateOnly(a.date) === todayString()
  );

  document.getElementById("sToday").textContent = today.length;

  document.getElementById("sBooked").textContent =
    today.filter(a=>a.status==="Booked").length;

  document.getElementById("sWaiting").textContent =
    today.filter(a=>a.status==="Waiting").length;

  document.getElementById("sConsult").textContent =
    today.filter(a=>a.status==="In Consultation").length;

  document.getElementById("sCompleted").textContent =
    today.filter(a=>a.status==="Completed").length;

  document.getElementById("sFollow").textContent =
    appointments.filter(a=>a.followUp === true).length;
}

function renderToday(){

  const box = document.getElementById("todayQueue");
  const today = todayString();

  const list = appointments
    .filter(a=>{
      return dateOnly(a.date) >= today &&
             a.status !== "Cancelled";
    })
    .sort((a,b)=>{

      const dc =
        dateOnly(a.date).localeCompare(dateOnly(b.date));

      if(dc !== 0) return dc;

      return String(a.time || "")
        .localeCompare(String(b.time || ""));
    });

  if(!list.length){
    box.innerHTML =
      '<div class="empty">No upcoming appointments.</div>';
    return;
  }

  box.innerHTML = `
  <div class="tablewrap">
  <table>
  <thead>
  <tr>
    <th>Patient</th>
    <th>Date</th>
    <th>Time</th>
    <th>Doctor</th>
    <th>Reason</th>
    <th>Status</th>
    <th>Actions</th>
  </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
  ${list.map(a=>`
    <tr>
      <td>
        <strong>${escapeHtml(a.patientName)}</strong>
        <br>
        <small>${escapeHtml(a.phone)}</small>
      </td>
      <td>${escapeHtml(a.date)}</td>
      <td>${escapeHtml(a.time)}</td>
      <td>${escapeHtml(a.doctorName || a.doctor || "-")}</td>
      <td>${escapeHtml(a.reason)}</td>
      <td>
        <span class="badge ${statusClass(a.status)}">
          ${escapeHtml(a.status)}
        </span>
      </td>
      <td>
        <div class="actions">
          <button class="btn primary" onclick="viewAppointment(${a.id})">View</button>
          <button class="btn warning" onclick="manageAppointment(${a.id})">Manage</button>
          ${
            a.status !== "Completed"
            ? `<button class="btn success" onclick="quickComplete(${a.id})">Complete</button>`
            : ""
          }
        </div>
      </td>
    </tr>
  `).join("")}
  </tbody>
  </table>
  </div>`;
}

function renderAppointments(){

  const box = document.getElementById("appointmentTable");

  const search =
    document.getElementById("searchInput").value
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase();

  const status =
    document.getElementById("statusFilter").value;

  const date =
    document.getElementById("dateFilter").value;

  const list = appointments.filter(a=>{

    const text = `
      ${a.patientName || ""}
      ${a.phone || ""}
      ${a.email || ""}
      ${a.doctorName || a.doctor || ""}
      ${a.reason || ""}
    `.toLowerCase();

    if(search && !text.includes(search)) return false;
    if(status && a.status !== status) return false;
    if(date && dateOnly(a.date) !== date) return false;

    return true;
  });

  if(!list.length){
    box.innerHTML =
      '<div class="empty">No appointments found.</div>';
    return;
  }

  box.innerHTML = `
  <div class="tablewrap">
  <table>
  <thead>
  <tr>
    <th>Patient</th>
    <th>Date</th>
    <th>Time</th>
    <th>Doctor</th>
    <th>Reason</th>
    <th>Status</th>
    <th>Actions</th>
  </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
  ${list.map(a=>`
  <tr>
    <td>
      <strong>${escapeHtml(a.patientName)}</strong>
      <br><small>${escapeHtml(a.phone)}</small>
    </td>
    <td>${escapeHtml(a.date)}</td>
    <td>${escapeHtml(a.time)}</td>
    <td>${escapeHtml(a.doctorName || a.doctor || "-")}</td>
    <td>${escapeHtml(a.reason)}</td>
    <td>
      <span class="badge ${statusClass(a.status)}">
        ${escapeHtml(a.status)}
      </span>
    </td>
    <td>
      <div class="actions">
        <button class="btn primary" onclick="viewAppointment(${a.id})">View</button>
        <button class="btn warning" onclick="manageAppointment(${a.id})">Manage</button>
      </div>
    </td>
  </tr>
  `).join("")}
  </tbody>
  </table>
  </div>`;
}

function clearFilters(){
  document.getElementById("searchInput").value="";
  document.getElementById("statusFilter").value="";
  document.getElementById("dateFilter").value="";
  renderAppointments();
}

function findAppointment(id){
  return appointments.find(a=>Number(a.id)===Number(id));
}

function viewAppointment(id){

  const a = findAppointment(id);

  if(!a) return;

  document.getElementById("viewContent").innerHTML = `
    <div class="formgrid">

      <div class="field">
        <label>Patient Name</label>
        <input value="${escapeHtml(a.patientName)}" readonly>
      </div>

      <div class="field">
        <label>Phone</label>
        <input value="${escapeHtml(a.phone)}" readonly>
      </div>

      <div class="field">
        <label>Email</label>
        <input value="${escapeHtml(a.email)}" readonly>
      </div>

      <div class="field">
        <label>Doctor</label>
        <input value="${escapeHtml(a.doctorName || a.doctor || "-")}" readonly>
      </div>

      <div class="field">
        <label>Date</label>
        <input value="${escapeHtml(a.date)}" readonly>
      </div>

      <div class="field">
        <label>Time</label>
        <input value="${escapeHtml(a.time)}" readonly>
      </div>

      <div class="field full">
        <label>Reason</label>
        <textarea readonly>${escapeHtml(a.reason)}</textarea>
      </div>

      <div class="field full">
        <label>Diagnosis</label>
        <textarea readonly>${escapeHtml(a.diagnosis || "Not added")}</textarea>
      </div>

      <div class="field full">
        <label>Clinical Notes</label>
        <textarea readonly>${escapeHtml(a.notes || "Not added")}</textarea>
      </div>

      <div class="field full">
        <label>Prescription</label>
        <textarea readonly>${escapeHtml(a.prescription || "Not added")}</textarea>
      </div>

    </div>
  `;

  document.getElementById("viewModal").classList.add("show");
}

function manageAppointment(id){

  const a = findAppointment(id);

  if(!a) return;

  currentAppointment = a;

  document.getElementById("managePatient").innerHTML = `
    <strong>${escapeHtml(a.patientName)}</strong>
    <p>
      ${escapeHtml(a.phone)} |
      ${escapeHtml(a.email)} |
      ${escapeHtml(a.date)} at ${escapeHtml(a.time)}
    </p>
  `;

  document.getElementById("mDiagnosis").value =
    a.diagnosis || "";

  document.getElementById("mNotes").value =
    a.notes || "";

  document.getElementById("mStatus").value =
    a.status || "Booked";

  document.getElementById("mPrescription").value =
    a.prescription || "";

  document.getElementById("mFollow").value =
    a.followUp ? "true" : "false";

  document.getElementById("mFollowDate").value =
    a.followUpDate || "";

  document.getElementById("mFollowNotes").value =
    a.followUpNotes || "";

  document.getElementById("mPaymentStatus").value =
    a.payment?.status || "Pending";

  document.getElementById("mPaymentAmount").value =
    a.payment?.amount || "";

  renderManageTests();

  openDefaultTab();

  document.getElementById("manageModal").classList.add("show");
}

function openDefaultTab(){

  document.querySelectorAll(".tab").forEach(x=>x.classList.remove("active"));
  document.querySelectorAll(".tabcontent").forEach(x=>x.classList.remove("active"));

  document.querySelector(".tab").classList.add("active");
  document.getElementById("diagnosis").classList.add("active");
}

function openTab(id,button){

  document.querySelectorAll(".tab").forEach(x=>x.classList.remove("active"));
  document.querySelectorAll(".tabcontent").forEach(x=>x.classList.remove("active"));

  button.classList.add("active");
  document.getElementById(id).classList.add("active");
}

function closeModal(id){
  document.getElementById(id).classList.remove("show");
}

async function apiPatch(url,body){

  const res = await fetch(url,{
    method:"PATCH",
    headers:authHeaders(),
    body:JSON.stringify(body)
  });

  const data = await res.json();

  if(!res.ok){
    throw new Error(data.message || "Request failed");
  }

  return data;
}

async function saveDiagnosis(){

  if(!currentAppointment) return;

  try{

    await apiPatch(
      `/api/appointments/${currentAppointment.id}/diagnosis`,
      {
        diagnosis:document.getElementById("mDiagnosis").value,
        notes:document.getElementById("mNotes").value
      }
    );

    await updateStatus(
      currentAppointment.id,
      document.getElementById("mStatus").value,
      false
    );

    showToast("Diagnosis saved");

  }catch(error){

    showToast(error.message);

  }
}

async function updateStatus(id,status,notify=true){

  try{

    await apiPatch(
      `/api/appointments/${id}/status`,
      {status}
    );

    const a=findAppointment(id);
    if(a) a.status=status;

    updateStats();
    renderToday();
    renderAppointments();

    if(notify) showToast("Status updated");

  }catch(error){

    showToast(error.message);

  }
}

async function quickComplete(id){

  await updateStatus(id,"Completed");
}

async function savePrescription(){

  if(!currentAppointment) return;

  try{

    await apiPatch(
      `/api/appointments/${currentAppointment.id}/prescription`,
      {
        prescription:
          document.getElementById("mPrescription").value
      }
    );

    const a=findAppointment(currentAppointment.id);

    if(a){
      a.prescription =
        document.getElementById("mPrescription").value;
    }

    showToast("Prescription saved");

  }catch(error){

    showToast(error.message);

  }
}

async function addTest(){

  if(!currentAppointment) return;

  const name =
    document.getElementById("mTestName").value.trim();

  if(!name){
    showToast("Enter test name");
    return;
  }

  try{

    await fetch(
      `/api/appointments/${currentAppointment.id}/tests`,
      {
        method:"POST",
        headers:authHeaders(),
        body:JSON.stringify({
          name,
          priority:document.getElementById("mTestPriority").value,
          instructions:
            document.getElementById("mTestInstructions").value
        })
      }
    );

    document.getElementById("mTestName").value="";
    document.getElementById("mTestInstructions").value="";

    await loadAppointments();

    currentAppointment=findAppointment(currentAppointment.id);

    renderManageTests();

    showToast("Test added");

  }catch(error){

    showToast("Test could not be added");

  }
}

function renderManageTests(){

  const box=document.getElementById("mTestsList");

  const tests=currentAppointment?.tests || [];

  if(!tests.length){

    box.innerHTML =
      '<div class="empty">No diagnostic tests added.</div>';

    return;
  }

  box.innerHTML=tests.map(t=>`
    <div class="patientbox">
      <strong>${escapeHtml(t.name)}</strong>
      <p>
        Priority: ${escapeHtml(t.priority || "Normal")}
        |
        Status: ${escapeHtml(t.status || "Requested")}
      </p>
      <p>${escapeHtml(t.instructions || "")}</p>
    </div>
  `).join("");
}

async function saveFollowup(){

  if(!currentAppointment) return;

  try{

    await apiPatch(
      `/api/appointments/${currentAppointment.id}/follow-up`,
      {
        followUp:
          document.getElementById("mFollow").value === "true",

        followUpDate:
          document.getElementById("mFollowDate").value,

        followUpNotes:
          document.getElementById("mFollowNotes").value
      }
    );

    const a=findAppointment(currentAppointment.id);

    if(a){
      a.followUp =
        document.getElementById("mFollow").value === "true";

      a.followUpDate =
        document.getElementById("mFollowDate").value;

      a.followUpNotes =
        document.getElementById("mFollowNotes").value;
    }

    updateStats();
    renderFollowups();

    showToast("Follow-up saved");

  }catch(error){

    showToast(error.message);

  }
}

async function savePayment(){

  if(!currentAppointment) return;

  try{

    await apiPatch(
      `/api/appointments/${currentAppointment.id}/payment`,
      {
        status:
          document.getElementById("mPaymentStatus").value,

        amount:
          Number(document.getElementById("mPaymentAmount").value || 0)
      }
    );

    showToast("Payment updated");

  }catch(error){

    showToast(error.message);

  }
}

function populateSelects(){

  const selects=[
    "clinicalSelect",
    "prescriptionSelect",
    "testSelect"
  ];

  selects.forEach(id=>{

    const select=document.getElementById(id);

    select.innerHTML =
      '<option value="">Select Appointment</option>' +

      appointments
      .filter(a=>a.status!=="Cancelled")
      .map(a=>`
        <option value="${a.id}">
          ${escapeHtml(a.patientName)}
          - ${escapeHtml(a.date)}
          ${escapeHtml(a.time)}
        </option>
      `).join("");
  });
}

function loadClinical(){

  const id=document.getElementById("clinicalSelect").value;

  const box=document.getElementById("clinicalBox");

  if(!id){
    box.innerHTML='<div class="empty">Select an appointment first.</div>';
    return;
  }

  const a=findAppointment(id);

  if(!a) return;

  box.innerHTML=`
    <div class="patientbox">
      <strong>${escapeHtml(a.patientName)}</strong>
      <p>${escapeHtml(a.date)} | ${escapeHtml(a.time)} | ${escapeHtml(a.phone)}</p>
    </div>

    <div class="formgrid">
      <div class="field full">
        <label>Diagnosis</label>
        <input id="cDiagnosis" value="${escapeHtml(a.diagnosis || "")}">
      </div>

      <div class="field full">
        <label>Clinical Notes</label>
        <textarea id="cNotes">${escapeHtml(a.notes || "")}</textarea>
      </div>

      <div class="field">
        <label>Status</label>
        <select id="cStatus">
          ${["Booked","Waiting","In Consultation","Completed","Cancelled"]
            .map(s=>`<option ${a.status===s?"selected":""}>${s}</option>`)
            .join("")}
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>

    <br>
    <button class="btn primary" onclick="saveClinicalPage(${a.id})">
      Save Clinical Record
    </button>
  `;
}

async function saveClinicalPage(id){

  try{

    await apiPatch(
      `/api/appointments/${id}/diagnosis`,
      {
        diagnosis:document.getElementById("cDiagnosis").value,
        notes:document.getElementById("cNotes").value
      }
    );

    await apiPatch(
      `/api/appointments/${id}/status`,
      {
        status:document.getElementById("cStatus").value
      }
    );

    await loadAppointments();

    showToast("Clinical record saved");

  }catch(error){

    showToast(error.message);

  }
}

function loadPrescription(){

  const id=document.getElementById("prescriptionSelect").value;
  const box=document.getElementById("prescriptionBox");

  if(!id){
    box.innerHTML='<div class="empty">Select an appointment first.</div>';
    return;
  }

  const a=findAppointment(id);

  box.innerHTML=`
    <div class="patientbox">
      <strong>${escapeHtml(a.patientName)}</strong>
      <p>${escapeHtml(a.date)} | ${escapeHtml(a.time)}</p>
    </div>

    <div class="field">
      <label>Prescription</label>
      <textarea id="pText" placeholder="Enter prescription instructions">${escapeHtml(a.prescription || "")}</textarea>
    </div>

    <br>
    <button class="btn primary" onclick="savePrescriptionPage(${a.id})">
      Save Prescription
    </button>
  `;
}

async function savePrescriptionPage(id){

  try{

    await apiPatch(
      `/api/appointments/${id}/prescription`,
      {
        prescription:
          document.getElementById("pText").value
      }
    );

    const a=findAppointment(id);

    if(a){
      a.prescription=
        document.getElementById("pText").value;
    }

    showToast("Prescription saved");

  }catch(error){

    showToast(error.message);

  }
}

function loadTests(){

  const id=document.getElementById("testSelect").value;
  const box=document.getElementById("testBox");

  if(!id){
    box.innerHTML='<div class="empty">Select an appointment first.</div>';
    return;
  }

  const a=findAppointment(id);

  box.innerHTML=`
    <div class="patientbox">
      <strong>${escapeHtml(a.patientName)}</strong>
      <p>${escapeHtml(a.date)} | ${escapeHtml(a.time)}</p>
    </div>

    <div class="formgrid">
      <div class="field">
        <label>Test Name</label>
        <input id="pageTestName" placeholder="Example: CBC">
      </div>

      <div class="field">
        <label>Priority</label>
        <select id="pageTestPriority">
          <option>Normal</option>
          <option>Urgent</option>
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="field full">
        <label>Instructions</label>
        <textarea id="pageTestInstructions"></textarea>
      </div>
    </div>

    <br>
    <button class="btn primary" onclick="addPageTest(${a.id})">
      Add Test
    </button>

    <div style="margin-top:20px">
      ${
        (a.tests || []).length
        ? a.tests.map(t=>`
          <div class="patientbox">
            <strong>${escapeHtml(t.name)}</strong>
            <p>
              Priority: ${escapeHtml(t.priority || "Normal")}
              | Status: ${escapeHtml(t.status || "Requested")}
            </p>
          </div>
        `).join("")
        : '<div class="empty">No tests added.</div>'
      }
    </div>
  `;
}

async function addPageTest(id){

  const name=document.getElementById("pageTestName").value.trim();

  if(!name){
    showToast("Enter test name");
    return;
  }

  try{

    await fetch(`/api/appointments/${id}/tests`,{
      method:"POST",
      headers:authHeaders(),
      body:JSON.stringify({
        name,
        priority:document.getElementById("pageTestPriority").value,
        instructions:
          document.getElementById("pageTestInstructions").value
      })
    });

    await loadAppointments();

    document.getElementById("testSelect").value=id;

    loadTests();

    showToast("Test added");

  }catch(error){

    showToast("Test could not be added");

  }
}

function renderFollowups(){

  const box=document.getElementById("followupList");

  const list=appointments.filter(a=>a.followUp===true);

  if(!list.length){

    box.innerHTML =
      '<div class="empty">No follow-ups currently scheduled.</div>';

    return;
  }

  box.innerHTML=`
    <div class="tablewrap">
    <table>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>Patient</th>
          <th>Follow-up Date</th>
          <th>Notes</th>
          <th>Actions</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
      ${list.map(a=>`
        <tr>
          <td>
            <strong>${escapeHtml(a.patientName)}</strong>
            <br><small>${escapeHtml(a.phone)}</small>
          </td>
          <td>${escapeHtml(a.followUpDate || "Not specified")}</td>
          <td>${escapeHtml(a.followUpNotes || "-")}</td>
          <td>
            <button class="btn warning"
              onclick="manageAppointment(${a.id})">
              Manage
            </button>
          </td>
        </tr>
      `).join("")}
      </tbody>
    </table>
    </div>
  `;
}

function showPage(id,button){

  document.querySelectorAll(".page")
    .forEach(p=>p.classList.remove("active"));

  document.getElementById(id)
    .classList.add("active");

  document.querySelectorAll(".navbtn")
    .forEach(b=>b.classList.remove("active"));

  button.classList.add("active");
}

function logout(){

  localStorage.removeItem("gjh_token");
  localStorage.removeItem("gjh_user");

  window.location.href="login.html";
}

document.getElementById("viewModal").addEventListener("click",e=>{
  if(e.target.id==="viewModal"){
    closeModal("viewModal");
  }
});

document.getElementById("manageModal").addEventListener("click",e=>{
  if(e.target.id==="manageModal"){
    closeModal("manageModal");
  }
});

verifyDoctor();
</script>

</html>

    <div class="panel-buttons">

        <button
            class="panel-btn"
            onclick="showEmergencyMessage()"
        >
            Emergency Assistance
        </button>


        <button
            class="panel-btn secondary"
            onclick="location.href='../index.html'"
        >
            Back to Hospital Website
        </button>

<script>

document.documentElement.style.visibility =
    "hidden";


let currentUser = null;

let patientAppointments = [];


// ====================================================
// AUTH
// ====================================================

async function verifyPatientAccess() {

    const token =
        localStorage.getItem(
            "gjh_token"
        );


    if (!token) {

        location.replace(
            "login.html"
        );

        return;

    }


    try {

        const response =
            await fetch(
                "/api/private/patient",
                {
                    headers: {
                        "Authorization":
                            "Bearer " + token
                    }
                }
            );


        const data =
            await response.json();


        if (
            !response.ok ||
            !data.success ||
            data.user?.role !== "patient"
        ) {

            throw new Error(
                "Access denied"
            );

        }


        currentUser =
            data.user;


        loadPatientProfile();


        document.documentElement.style.visibility =
            "visible";


        await loadPatientAppointments();


    } catch (error) {

        localStorage.removeItem(
            "gjh_token"
        );

        localStorage.removeItem(
            "gjh_user"
        );

        location.replace(
            "login.html"
        );

    }

}


// ====================================================
// PROFILE
// ====================================================

function loadPatientProfile() {

    if (!currentUser) {
        return;
    }


    document.getElementById(
        "patientNameDisplay"
    ).textContent =
        currentUser.name ||
        "Patient";


    document.getElementById(
        "patientInfoName"
    ).textContent =
        currentUser.name ||
        "Not available";


    document.getElementById(
        "patientInfoEmail"
    ).textContent =
        currentUser.email ||
        "Not available";


    document.getElementById(
        "patientInfoPhone"
    ).textContent =
        currentUser.phone ||
        "Not available";


    document.getElementById(
        "patientInfoId"
    ).textContent =
        "GJH-" +
        String(
            currentUser.id
        ).padStart(4,"0");

}


// ====================================================
// LOAD APPOINTMENTS
// ====================================================

async function loadPatientAppointments() {

    const table =
        document.getElementById(
            "patientAppointments"
        );


    table.innerHTML = `

        <tr>

            <td colspan="5">
                Loading appointments...
            </td>

        </tr>

    `;


    try {

        const token =
            localStorage.getItem(
                "gjh_token"
            );


        const response =
            await fetch(
                "/api/appointments",
                {
                    headers: {
                        "Authorization":
                            "Bearer " + token
                    }
                }
            );


        const data =
            await response.json();


        if (!response.ok) {

            throw new Error(
                data.message ||
                "Unable to load appointments"
            );

        }


        const allAppointments =
            Array.isArray(
                data.appointments
            )
                ? data.appointments
                : [];


        const patientEmail =
            String(
                currentUser?.email ||
                ""
            )
            .trim()
            .toLowerCase();


        patientAppointments =
            allAppointments.filter(
                appointment =>
                    String(
                        appointment.email ||
                        ""
                    )
                    .trim()
                    .toLowerCase() ===
                    patientEmail
            );


        renderPatientAppointments();


        updatePatientDashboard();


        renderClinicalInformation();


        renderPrescriptionInformation();


        renderLabInformation();


        renderBillInformation();


        renderFollowupInformation();


    } catch (error) {

        console.error(error);


        table.innerHTML = `

            <tr>

                <td colspan="5">
                    Unable to load appointments.
                </td>

            </tr>

        `;

    }

}


// ====================================================
// APPOINTMENTS TABLE
// ====================================================

function renderPatientAppointments() {

    const table =
        document.getElementById(
            "patientAppointments"
        );


    if (!patientAppointments.length) {

        table.innerHTML = `

            <tr>

                <td colspan="5">
                    No appointments found.
                </td>

            </tr>

        `;

        return;

    }


    table.innerHTML =
        patientAppointments
        .map(
            appointment => `

            <tr>

                <td>

                    ${escapeHtml(
                        appointment.doctorName ||
                        appointment.doctor ||
                        "Not available"
                    )}

                </td>


                <td>

                    ${escapeHtml(
                        appointment.specialty ||
                        "General"
                    )}

                </td>


                <td>

                    ${escapeHtml(
                        appointment.date ||
                        "-"
                    )}

                </td>


                <td>

                    ${escapeHtml(
                        appointment.time ||
                        "-"
                    )}

                </td>


                <td>

                    <span class="status">

                        ${escapeHtml(
                            appointment.status ||
                            "Booked"
                        )}

                    </span>

                </td>

            </tr>

        `
        )
        .join("");

}


// ====================================================
// DASHBOARD
// ====================================================

function updatePatientDashboard() {

    const upcoming =
        patientAppointments.filter(
            a =>
                a.status !== "Completed" &&
                a.status !== "Cancelled"
        );


    const prescriptions =
        patientAppointments.filter(
            a =>
                String(
                    a.prescription ||
                    ""
                ).trim()
        );


    const reports =
        patientAppointments.reduce(
            (total,a) =>
                total +
                (
                    Array.isArray(a.tests)
                        ? a.tests.filter(
                            test =>
                                String(
                                    test.report ||
                                    ""
                                ).trim()
                        ).length
                        : 0
                ),
            0
        );


    const pendingBills =
        patientAppointments.reduce(
            (total,a) => {

                const payment =
                    a.payment || {};


                if (
                    payment.status ===
                    "Pending"
                ) {

                    return total +
                        (
                            Number(
                                payment.amount
                            ) || 0
                        );

                }


                return total;

            },
            0
        );


    document.getElementById(
        "appointmentCount"
    ).textContent =
        upcoming.length;


    document.getElementById(
        "prescriptionCount"
    ).textContent =
        prescriptions.length;


    document.getElementById(
        "reportCount"
    ).textContent =
        reports;


    document.getElementById(
        "pendingBills"
    ).textContent =
        "₹" +
        pendingBills;

}


// ====================================================
// CLINICAL INFORMATION
// ====================================================

function renderClinicalInformation() {

    const box =
        document.getElementById(
            "clinicalInformation"
        );


    const records =
        patientAppointments.filter(
            a =>
                String(
                    a.diagnosis ||
                    ""
                ).trim() ||
                String(
                    a.clinicalNotes ||
                    ""
                ).trim()
        );


    if (!records.length) {

        box.innerHTML = `

            <div class="empty">
                No clinical information available yet.
            </div>

        `;

        return;

    }


    box.innerHTML =
        records.map(
            a => `

            <div class="data-card">

                <h3>
                    ${escapeHtml(
                        a.doctorName ||
                        a.doctor ||
                        "Doctor"
                    )}
                </h3>


                <p>
                    <strong>
                        Appointment:
                    </strong>

                    ${escapeHtml(a.date)}
                    ${escapeHtml(a.time)}
                </p>


                <p style="margin-top:8px">

                    <strong>
                        Diagnosis:
                    </strong>

                    ${escapeHtml(
                        a.diagnosis ||
                        "Not recorded"
                    )}

                </p>


                <p style="margin-top:8px">

                    <strong>
                        Clinical Notes:
                    </strong>

                    ${escapeHtml(
                        a.clinicalNotes ||
                        "Not recorded"
                    )}

                </p>

            </div>

        `
        )
        .join("");

}


// ====================================================
// PRESCRIPTIONS
// ====================================================

function renderPrescriptionInformation() {

}


// ====================================================
// LAB REPORTS
// ====================================================

function renderLabInformation() {

    const box =
        document.getElementById(
            "labInformation"
        );


    const reports = [];


    patientAppointments.forEach(
        appointment => {

            if (
                !Array.isArray(
                    appointment.tests
                )
            ) {
                return;
            }


            appointment.tests.forEach(
                test => {

                    if (
                        String(
                            test.report ||
                            ""
                        ).trim()
                    ) {

                        reports.push({

                            appointment,

                            test

                        });

                    }

                }
            );

        }
    );


    if (!reports.length) {

        box.innerHTML = `

            <div class="empty">
                No laboratory reports available yet.
            </div>

        `;

        return;

    }


    box.innerHTML =
        reports.map(
            item => `

            <div class="data-card">

                <h3>
                    ${escapeHtml(
                        item.test.name
                    )}
                </h3>


                <p>

                    <strong>
                        Doctor:
                    </strong>

                    ${escapeHtml(
                        item.appointment.doctorName ||
                        item.appointment.doctor ||
                        "Doctor"
                    )}

                </p>


                <p style="margin-top:8px">

                    <strong>
                        Status:
                    </strong>

                    ${escapeHtml(
                        item.test.status ||
                        "Completed"
                    )}

                </p>


                <p style="margin-top:8px">

                    <strong>
                        Report:
                    </strong>

                </p>


                <p style="white-space:pre-wrap">

                    ${escapeHtml(
                        item.test.report
                    )}

                </p>

            </div>

        `
        )
        .join("");

}


// ====================================================
// BILL INFORMATION
// ====================================================

function renderBillInformation() {

    const box =
        document.getElementById(
            "billInformation"
        );


    if (!patientAppointments.length) {

        box.innerHTML = `

            <div class="empty">
                No billing information available yet.
            </div>

        `;

        return;

    }


    box.innerHTML =
        patientAppointments.map(
            a => {

                const payment =
                    a.payment || {};


                return `

                <div class="data-card">

                    <h3>
                        Appointment Bill
                    </h3>


                    <p>

                        <strong>
                            Doctor:
                        </strong>

                        ${escapeHtml(
                            a.doctorName ||
                            a.doctor ||
                            "Doctor"
                        )}

                    </p>


                    <p>

                        <strong>
                            Date:
                        </strong>

                        ${escapeHtml(a.date)}

                    </p>


                    <p>

                        <strong>
                            Amount:
                        </strong>

                        ₹${escapeHtml(
                            payment.amount ||
                            a.fee ||
                            0
                        )}

                    </p>


                    <p>

                        <strong>
                            Payment Status:
                        </strong>

                        ${escapeHtml(
                            payment.status ||
                            "Pending"
                        )}

                    </p>


                    ${
                        payment.method
                            ? `<p>
                                <strong>
                                    Method:
                                </strong>
                                ${escapeHtml(
                                    payment.method
                                )}
                               </p>`
                            : ""
                    }

                </div>

                `;

            }
        )
        .join("");

}


// ====================================================
// FOLLOW UP
// ====================================================

function renderFollowupInformation() {

    const box =
        document.getElementById(
            "followupInformation"
        );


    const records =
        patientAppointments.filter(
            a =>
                a.followUp === true
        );


    if (!records.length) {

            </div>
