        return;

    }


    box.innerHTML =
        records.map(
            a => `

            <div class="data-card">

                <h3>
                    Follow-up Required
                </h3>


                <p>

                    <strong>
                        Doctor:
                    </strong>

                    ${escapeHtml(
                        a.doctorName ||
                        a.doctor ||
                        "Doctor"
                    )}

                </p>


                ${
                    a.followUpDate
                        ? `<p>
                            <strong>
                                Follow-up Date:
                            </strong>
                            ${escapeHtml(
                                a.followUpDate
                            )}
                           </p>`
                        : ""
                }


                ${
                    a.followUpNotes
                        ? `<p style="margin-top:8px">
                            <strong>
                                Notes:
                            </strong>
                            ${escapeHtml(
                                a.followUpNotes
                            )}
                           </p>`
                        : ""
                }

            </div>

        `
        )
        .join("");

}

function logoutPatient() {

    localStorage.removeItem(

    );

    window.location.href =
        "login.html";

}


// ====================================================
// EMERGENCY
// ====================================================

function showEmergencyMessage() {

    alert(
        "For a real medical emergency, contact local emergency services or go to the nearest emergency department immediately."
    );

}


// ====================================================
// HTML SECURITY
// ====================================================

function escapeHtml(value) {

    return String(value ?? "")
        .replace(/&/g,"&amp;")
        .replace(/</g,"&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g,"&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g,"&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g,"&#039;");

}

<script>
document.documentElement.style.visibility = "hidden";

async function verifyReceptionAccess(){

    const token = localStorage.getItem("gjh_token");

    if(!token){
        window.location.replace("login.html");
        return;
    }

    try{

        const response = await fetch(
            "/api/private/reception",
            {
                headers:{
                    "Authorization":"Bearer " + token
                }
            }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if(
            !response.ok ||
            !data.success ||
            !data.user ||
            data.user.role !== "reception"
        ){

            localStorage.removeItem("gjh_token");
            localStorage.removeItem("gjh_user");

            alert(
                "Access denied. Only authorized reception staff can open this panel."
            );

            window.location.replace("login.html");
            return;
        }

        localStorage.setItem(
            "gjh_user",
            JSON.stringify(data.user)
        );

        document.documentElement.style.visibility = "visible";

    }catch(error){

        alert("Unable to verify reception login.");
        window.location.replace("login.html");
    }
}

verifyReceptionAccess();
</script>

/* ================= HELPERS ================= */

function escapeHTML(value){

    return String(value ?? "")
        .replace(/&/g,"&amp;")
        .replace(/</g,"&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g,"&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g,"&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g,"&#039;");
}

function getToday(){

    const d = new Date();

    const year =
        d.getFullYear();

    const month =
        String(
            d.getMonth()+1
        ).padStart(2,"0");

    const day =
        String(
            d.getDate()
        ).padStart(2,"0");

    return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
}

function todayDisplay(){

    return new Date().toLocaleDateString();
}

function statusBadge(status){

    let cls =
        "badge-booked";

    if(status === "Waiting"){
        cls = "badge-waiting";
    }

    if(status === "Checked In"){
        cls = "badge-consultation";
    }

    if(status === "Completed"){
        cls = "badge-completed";
    }

    if(status === "Cancelled"){
        cls = "badge-cancelled";
    }

    if(status === "Available"){
        cls = "badge-available";
    }

    if(status === "Occupied"){
        cls = "badge-occupied";
    }

    if(status === "Reserved"){
        cls = "badge-reserved";
    }

    if(status === "Cleaning"){
        cls = "badge-cleaning";
    }

    if(status === "Admitted"){
        cls = "badge-admitted";
    }

    if(status === "Discharged"){
        cls = "badge-discharged";
    }

    return `
        <span class="badge ${cls}">
            ${escapeHTML(status)}
        </span>
    `;
}

/* ================= PAGE NAVIGATION ================= */

function showPage(pageId,button){

    document
        .querySelectorAll(".page")
        .forEach(
            page =>
                page.classList.remove(
                    "active"
                )
        );

    const page =
        document.getElementById(
            pageId
        );

    if(page){
        page.classList.add("active");
    }

    document
        .querySelectorAll(".nav-btn")
        .forEach(
            btn =>
                btn.classList.remove(
                    "active"
                )
        );

    if(button){
        button.classList.add("active");
    }

    window.scrollTo({
        top:0,
        behavior:"smooth"
    });
}

function showPageByName(pageId){

    const button =
        [...document.querySelectorAll(".nav-btn")]
        .find(
            btn =>
                btn.getAttribute("onclick")
                ?.includes(
                    `'${pageId}'`
                )
        );

    showPage(
        pageId,
        button
    );
}

/* ================= PATIENT REGISTRATION ================= */

document
.getElementById("patientForm")
.addEventListener(
"submit",
function(e){

    e.preventDefault();

    const name =
        document
        .getElementById(
            "patientName"
        )
        .value
        .trim();

    const phone =
        document
        .getElementById(
            "patientPhone"
        )
        .value
        .trim();

    if(!name || !phone){

        alert(
            "Patient name and phone are required."
        );

        return;
    }

    const duplicate =
        patients.find(
            p =>
                p.phone === phone
        );

    if(duplicate){

        alert(
            "A patient with this phone number already exists.\nPatient ID: "
            + duplicate.id
        );

        return;
    }

    const patient = {

        id:
            "GJH-P" +
            String(
                Date.now()
            ).slice(-7),

        name,

        age:
            Number(
                document
                .getElementById(
                    "patientAge"
                )
                .value
            ),

        gender:
            document
            .getElementById(
                "patientGender"
            )
            .value,

        phone,

        email:
            document
            .getElementById(
                "patientEmail"
            )
            .value
            .trim(),

        city:
            document
            .getElementById(
                "patientCity"
            )
            .value
            .trim(),

        address:
            document
            .getElementById(
                "patientAddress"
            )
            .value
            .trim(),

        registeredAt:
            new Date().toISOString()

    };

    patients.push(patient);

    saveAll();

    this.reset();

    renderAll();

    alert(
        "Patient registered successfully!\n\nPatient ID: "
        + patient.id
    );

    showPageByName("patients");

});

function renderPatientDropdowns(){

    const dropdownIds = [

        "appointmentPatient",
        "billingPatient",
        "admissionPatient"

    ];

    const options =
        patients
        .map(

                <option value="${escapeHTML(p.id)}">
                    ${escapeHTML(p.name)}
                    (${escapeHTML(p.id)})
                </option>

            `
        )
        .join("");

    dropdownIds.forEach(
        id => {

            const select =
                document.getElementById(
                    id
                );

            if(!select) return;

            select.innerHTML =
                `
                <option value="">
                    Select Patient
                </option>
                `
                +
                options;

        }
    );
}

/* ================= PATIENT SEARCH ================= */

function renderPatientList(){

    const box =
        document.getElementById(
            "patientList"
        );

    const query =
        document
        .getElementById(
            "patientSearch"
        )
        .value
        .toLowerCase()
        .trim();

    const filtered =
        patients.filter(
            p => {

                const text =
                    `
                    ${p.name}
                    ${p.id}
                    ${p.phone}
                    ${p.city}
                    `
                    .toLowerCase();

                return text.includes(query);

            }
        );

    if(filtered.length === 0){

        box.innerHTML =
            `
            <div class="empty">
                No patient records found.
            </div>
            `;

        return;
    }

    box.innerHTML =
        filtered
        .map(
            p => `

            <div class="patient-card">

                <h4>
                    ${escapeHTML(p.name)}
                </h4>

                <div class="patient-meta">

                    <span>
                        <strong>ID:</strong>
                        ${escapeHTML(p.id)}
                    </span>

                    <span>
                        <strong>Age:</strong>
                        ${escapeHTML(p.age)}
                    </span>

                    <span>
                        <strong>Gender:</strong>
                        ${escapeHTML(p.gender)}
                    </span>

                    <span>
                        <strong>Phone:</strong>
                        ${escapeHTML(p.phone)}
                    </span>

                    <span>
                        <strong>City:</strong>
                        ${escapeHTML(p.city || "-")}
                    </span>

                    <span>
                        <strong>Email:</strong>
                        ${escapeHTML(p.email || "-")}
                    </span>

                </div>

                <div class="quick-actions">

                    <button
                        class="btn btn-primary"
                        onclick="viewPatient('${escapeHTML(p.id)}')"
                    >
                        View
                    </button>

                    <button
                        class="btn btn-blue"
                        onclick="usePatient('${escapeHTML(p.id)}')"
                    >
                        Book Appointment
                    </button>

                    <button
                        class="btn btn-green"
                        onclick="usePatientForBilling('${escapeHTML(p.id)}')"
                    >
                        Billing
                    </button>

                </div>

            </div>

            `
        )
        .join("");
}

function viewPatient(id){

    const patient =
        patients.find(
            p => p.id === id
        );

    if(!patient) return;

    const appointmentCount =
        appointments.filter(
            a =>
                a.patientId === id
        ).length;

    const admission =
        admissions
        .slice()
        .reverse()
        .find(
            a =>
                a.patientId === id &&
                a.status === "Admitted"
        );

    document.getElementById(
        "patientModalContent"
    ).innerHTML = `

        <div class="summary-item">
            <strong>Patient ID</strong>
            <span>${escapeHTML(patient.id)}</span>
        </div>

        <div class="summary-item">
            <strong>Name</strong>
            <span>${escapeHTML(patient.name)}</span>
        </div>

        <div class="summary-item">
            <strong>Age</strong>
            <span>${escapeHTML(patient.age)}</span>
        </div>

        <div class="summary-item">
            <strong>Gender</strong>
            <span>${escapeHTML(patient.gender)}</span>
        </div>

        <div class="summary-item">
            <strong>Phone</strong>
            <span>${escapeHTML(patient.phone)}</span>
        </div>

        <div class="summary-item">
            <strong>Email</strong>
            <span>${escapeHTML(patient.email || "-")}</span>
        </div>

        <div class="summary-item">
            <strong>City</strong>
            <span>${escapeHTML(patient.city || "-")}</span>
        </div>

        <div class="summary-item">
            <strong>Appointments</strong>
            <span>${appointmentCount}</span>
        </div>

        <div class="summary-item">
            <strong>Admission</strong>
            <span>
                ${
                    admission
                    ? escapeHTML(
                        admission.room +
                        " / " +
                        admission.bed
                    )
                    : "Not admitted"
                }
            </span>
        </div>

    `;

    document
        .getElementById(
            "patientModal"
        )
        .classList.add("show");
}

/* ================= APPOINTMENT ================= */

document
.getElementById("appointmentForm")
.addEventListener(
"submit",
function(e){

    e.preventDefault();

    const patientId =
        document
        .getElementById(
            "appointmentPatient"
        )
        .value;

    const patient =
        patients.find(
            p => p.id === patientId
        );

    if(!patient){

        alert(
            "Please select a patient."
        );

        return;
    }

    const date =
        document
        .getElementById(
            "appointmentDate"
        )
        .value;

    const time =
        document
        .getElementById(
            "appointmentTime"
        )
        .value;

    const doctor =
        document
        .getElementById(
            "appointmentDoctor"
        )
        .value;

    if(!date || !time || !doctor){

        alert(
            "Please complete appointment details."
        );

        return;
    }

    const token =
        ++tokenCounter;

    const appointment = {

        id:
            Date.now(),

        token,

        patientId,

        patientName:
            patient.name,

        doctor,

        date,

        time,

        reason:
            document
            .getElementById(
                "appointmentReason"
            )
            .value
            .trim(),

        status:"Booked",

        createdAt:
            new Date().toISOString()

    };

    appointments.push(
        appointment
    );

    saveAll();

    this.reset();

    setTodayDefaults();

    renderAll();

    alert(
        "Appointment booked successfully!\n\n"
        +
        "Patient: "
        + patient.name
        + "\nToken: #"
        + token
    );

});

/* ================= APPOINTMENT RENDER ================= */

function renderAppointments(){

    const tbody =
        document.getElementById(
            "appointmentTable"
        );

    const query =
        document
        .getElementById(
            "appointmentSearch"
        )
        .value
        .toLowerCase()
        .trim();

    const status =
        document
        .getElementById(
            "appointmentStatusFilter"
        )
        .value;

    const filtered =
        appointments
        .filter(
            a => {

                const text =
                    `
                    ${a.patientName}
                    ${a.doctor}
                    ${a.token}
                    ${a.date}
                    ${a.reason}
                    `
                    .toLowerCase();

                const searchMatch =
                    text.includes(query);

                const statusMatch =
                    !status ||
                    a.status === status;

                return (
                    searchMatch &&
                    statusMatch
                );

            }
        )
        .sort(
            (a,b) =>
                (
                    a.date + " " + a.time
                ).localeCompare(
                    b.date + " " + b.time
                )
        );

    if(filtered.length === 0){

        tbody.innerHTML =
            `
            <tr>
                <td
                    colspan="8"
                    class="empty"
                >
                    No appointment records found.
                </td>
            </tr>
            `;

        return;
    }

    tbody.innerHTML =
        filtered
        .map(
            a => `

            <tr>

                <td>
                    <strong>
                        #${escapeHTML(a.token)}
                    </strong>
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(a.patientName)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(a.doctor)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(a.date)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(a.time)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(a.reason)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${statusBadge(a.status)}
                </td>

                <td>

                    ${
                        a.status === "Booked"
                        ?
                        `
                        <button
                            class="btn btn-green"
                            onclick="checkIn(${a.id})"
                        >
                            Check In
                        </button>

                        <button
                            class="btn btn-orange"
                            onclick="rescheduleAppointment(${a.id})"
                        >
                            Reschedule
                        </button>

                        <button
                            class="btn btn-red"
                            onclick="cancelAppointment(${a.id})"
                        >
                            Cancel
                        </button>
                        `
                        :
                        ""
                    }

                    ${
                        a.status === "Waiting"
                        ?
                        `
                        <button
                            class="btn btn-blue"
                            onclick="startConsultation(${a.id})"
                        >
                            Start Consultation
                        </button>
                        `
                        :
                        ""
                    }

                    ${
                        a.status === "Checked In"
                        ?
                        `
                        <button
                            class="btn btn-green"
                            onclick="completeAppointment(${a.id})"
                        >
                            Complete
                        </button>
                        `
                        :
                        ""
                    }

                </td>

            </tr>

            `
        )
        .join("");
}

/* ================= CHECK IN ================= */

function checkIn(id){

    const appointment =
        appointments.find(
            a => a.id === id
        );

    if(!appointment) return;

    appointment.status =
        "Waiting";

    saveAll();

    renderAll();

    alert(
        "Patient checked in successfully and added to waiting queue."
    );
}

/* ================= CONSULTATION ================= */

function startConsultation(id){

    const appointment =
        appointments.find(
            a => a.id === id
        );

    if(!appointment) return;

    appointment.status =
        "Checked In";

    saveAll();

    renderAll();

    alert(
        "Patient moved to consultation."
    );
}

/* ================= COMPLETE ================= */

function completeAppointment(id){

    const appointment =
        appointments.find(
            a => a.id === id
        );

    if(!appointment) return;

    appointment.status =
        "Completed";

    saveAll();

    renderAll();

    alert(
        "Appointment marked completed."
    );
}

/* ================= CANCEL ================= */

function cancelAppointment(id){

    const appointment =
        appointments.find(
            a => a.id === id
        );

    if(!appointment) return;

    if(
        !confirm(
            "Cancel this appointment?"
        )
    ){
        return;
    }

    appointment.status =
        "Cancelled";

    saveAll();

    renderAll();

    alert(
        "Appointment cancelled."
    );
}

/* ================= RESCHEDULE ================= */

function rescheduleAppointment(id){

    const appointment =
        appointments.find(
            a => a.id === id
        );

    if(!appointment) return;

    const newDate =
        prompt(
            "Enter new date (YYYY-MM-DD):",
            appointment.date
        );

    if(!newDate) return;

    const newTime =
        prompt(
            "Enter new time (HH:MM):",
            appointment.time
        );

    if(!newTime) return;

    appointment.date =
        newDate;

    appointment.time =
        newTime;

    appointment.status =
        "Booked";

    saveAll();

    renderAll();

    alert(
        "Appointment rescheduled successfully."
    );
}

/* ================= TOKEN ================= */

function generateManualToken(){

    tokenCounter++;

    saveAll();

    renderAll();

    alert(
        "Next token generated: #" +
        tokenCounter
    );
}

/* ================= QUEUE ================= */

function renderQueue(){

    const queue =
        appointments
        .filter(
            a =>
                a.date === getToday() &&
                (
                    a.status === "Waiting" ||
                    a.status === "Checked In"
                )
        )
        .sort(
            (a,b) =>
                Number(a.token) -
                Number(b.token)
        );

    const box =
        document.getElementById(
            "queueList"
        );

    if(queue.length === 0){

        box.innerHTML =
            `
            <div class="empty">
                No patients currently waiting.
            </div>
            `;

    }else{

        box.innerHTML =
            queue
            .map(
                a => `

                <div class="queue-card">

                    <div class="queue-number">
                        #${escapeHTML(a.token)}
                    </div>

                    <div class="queue-name">
                        ${escapeHTML(a.patientName)}
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        ${escapeHTML(a.doctor)}
                    </div>

                    <div style="margin-top:7px">

                        ${statusBadge(a.status)}

                        ${
                            a.status === "Waiting"
                            ?
                            `
                            <button
                                class="btn btn-blue"
                                onclick="startConsultation(${a.id})"
                            >
                                Start
                            </button>
                            `
                            :
                            `
                            <button
                                class="btn btn-green"
                                onclick="completeAppointment(${a.id})"
                            >
                                Complete
                            </button>
                            `
                        }

                    </div>

                </div>

                `
            )
            .join("");

    }

    const summary =
        document.getElementById(
            "queueSummary"
        );

    const waiting =
        queue.filter(
            a => a.status === "Waiting"
        ).length;

    const consultation =
        queue.filter(
            a => a.status === "Checked In"
        ).length;

    summary.innerHTML = `

        <div class="alert info">
            <strong>Waiting:</strong>
            ${waiting}
        </div>

        <div class="alert success">
            <strong>In Consultation:</strong>
            ${consultation}
        </div>

        <div class="alert">
            <strong>Total Active Queue:</strong>
            ${queue.length}
        </div>

    `;
}

/* ================= BILLING ================= */

document
.getElementById("billingForm")
.addEventListener(
"submit",
function(e){

    e.preventDefault();

    const patientId =
        document
        .getElementById(
            "billingPatient"
        )
        .value;

    const patient =
        patients.find(
            p => p.id === patientId
        );

    if(!patient){

        alert(
            "Please select a patient."
        );

        return;
    }

    const amount =
        Number(
            document
            .getElementById(
                "billingAmount"
            )
            .value
        );

    if(
        !Number.isFinite(amount) ||
        amount < 0
    ){

        alert(
            "Please enter a valid amount."
        );

        return;
    }

    const bill = {

        id:
            "BILL-" +
            Date.now(),

        patientId,

        patientName:
            patient.name,

        service:
            document
            .getElementById(
                "billingService"
            )
            .value,

        amount,

        method:
            document
            .getElementById(
                "paymentMethod"
            )
            .value,

        status:"Paid",

        date:
            new Date().toLocaleString()

    };

    bills.push(bill);

    saveAll();

    this.reset();

    renderAll();

    alert(
        "Bill created successfully!\nBill ID: "
        + bill.id
    );

});

/* ================= BILLING TABLE ================= */

function renderBilling(){

    const tbody =
        document.getElementById(
            "billingTable"
        );

    if(bills.length === 0){

        tbody.innerHTML =
            `
            <tr>
                <td
                    colspan="7"
                    class="empty"
                >
                    No billing records found.
                </td>
            </tr>
            `;

        return;
    }

    tbody.innerHTML =
        bills
        .slice()
        .reverse()
        .map(
            b => `

            <tr>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(b.id)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(b.patientName)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(b.service)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ₹${Number(b.amount).toFixed(2)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(b.method)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(b.date)}
                </td>

                <td>

                    <button
                        class="btn btn-blue"
                        onclick="printBill('${escapeHTML(b.id)}')"
                    >
                        Receipt
                    </button>

                </td>

            </tr>

            `
        )
        .join("");
}

/* ================= PRINT BILL ================= */

function printBill(id){

    const bill =
        bills.find(
            b => b.id === id
        );

    if(!bill) return;

    const win =
        window.open(
            "",
            "_blank",
            "width=700,height=700"
        );

    if(!win){

        alert(
            "Please allow pop-ups to print the receipt."
        );

        return;
    }

    win.document.write(`

        <!DOCTYPE html>

        <html>

        <head>

            <title>
                Gopal Joshi Hospital Receipt
            </title>

            <style>

                body{
                    font-family:Arial;
                    padding:40px;
                    color:#1e293b;
                }

                .header{
                    text-align:center;
                    border-bottom:2px solid #0369a1;
                    padding-bottom:20px;
                }

                h1{
                    color:#0369a1;
                    margin-bottom:5px;
                }

                .receipt{
                    max-width:600px;
                    margin:auto;
                }

                .row{
                    display:flex;
                    justify-content:space-between;
                    padding:12px 0;
                    border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;
                }

                .total{
                    font-size:20px;
                    font-weight:bold;
                }

                .footer{
                    margin-top:30px;
                    text-align:center;
                    color:#64748b;
                }

            </style>

        </head>

        <body>

            <div class="receipt">

                <div class="header">

                    <h1>
                        Gopal Joshi Hospital
                    </h1>

                    <p>
                        Payment Receipt
                    </p>

                </div>

                <div class="row">
                    <strong>Bill ID</strong>
                    <span>${escapeHTML(bill.id)}</span>
                </div>

                <div class="row">
                    <strong>Patient</strong>
                    <span>${escapeHTML(bill.patientName)}</span>
                </div>

                <div class="row">
                    <strong>Service</strong>
                    <span>${escapeHTML(bill.service)}</span>
                </div>

                <div class="row">
                    <strong>Payment Method</strong>
                    <span>${escapeHTML(bill.method)}</span>
                </div>

                <div class="row total">
                    <strong>Total</strong>
                    <span>₹${Number(bill.amount).toFixed(2)}</span>
                </div>

                <div class="row">
                    <strong>Date</strong>
                    <span>${escapeHTML(bill.date)}</span>
                </div>

                <div class="footer">

                    <p>
                        Thank you for choosing
                        Gopal Joshi Hospital.
                    </p>

                    <p>
                        Demo project receipt.
                    </p>

                </div>

            </div>

        </body>

        </html>

    `);

    win.document.close();

    setTimeout(
        () => win.print(),
        300
    );
}

/* ================= BEDS ================= */

function renderBeds(){

    const tbody =
        document.getElementById(
            "bedTable"
        );

    const available =
        beds.filter(
            b => b.status === "Available"
        ).length;

    const occupied =
        beds.filter(
            b => b.status === "Occupied"
        ).length;

    const reserved =
        beds.filter(
            b => b.status === "Reserved"
        ).length;

    const cleaning =
        beds.filter(
            b => b.status === "Cleaning"
        ).length;

    document.getElementById(
        "bedAvailableCount"
    ).textContent =
        available;

    document.getElementById(
        "bedOccupiedCount"
    ).textContent =
        occupied;

    document.getElementById(
        "bedReservedCount"
    ).textContent =
        reserved;

    document.getElementById(
        "bedCleaningCount"
    ).textContent =
        cleaning;

    if(beds.length === 0){

        tbody.innerHTML =
            `
            <tr>
                <td
                    colspan="5"
                    class="empty"
                >
                    No bed records available.
                </td>
            </tr>
            `;

        return;
    }

    tbody.innerHTML =
        beds
        .map(
            b => `

            <tr>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(b.room)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(b.bed)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(b.type)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${statusBadge(b.status)}
                </td>

                <td>

                    ${
                        b.status === "Available"
                        ?
                        `
                        <button
                            class="btn btn-orange"
                            onclick="reserveBed(${b.id})"
                        >
                            Reserve
                        </button>
                        `
                        :
                        ""
                    }

                    ${
                        b.status === "Reserved"
                        ?
                        `
                        <button
                            class="btn btn-green"
                            onclick="makeBedAvailable(${b.id})"
                        >
                            Available
                        </button>
                        `
                        :
                        ""
                    }

                </td>

            </tr>

            `
        )
        .join("");

    renderAdmissionBeds();
}

/* ================= BED ACTIONS ================= */

function reserveBed(id){

    const bed =
        beds.find(
            b => b.id === id
        );

    if(!bed) return;

    bed.status =
        "Reserved";

    saveAll();

    renderAll();

    alert(
        "Bed reserved successfully."
    );
}

function makeBedAvailable(id){

    const bed =
        beds.find(
            b => b.id === id
        );

    if(!bed) return;

    bed.status =
        "Available";

    saveAll();

    renderAll();

    alert(
        "Bed is now available."
    );
}

function renderAdmissionBeds(){

    const select =
        document.getElementById(
            "admissionBed"
        );

    const available =
        beds.filter(
            b =>
                b.status === "Available"
        );

    select.innerHTML =
        `
        <option value="">
            Select Available Bed
        </option>
        `
        +
        available
        .map(
            b => `

            <option value="${b.id}">
                ${escapeHTML(b.room)}
                -
                ${escapeHTML(b.bed)}
                (${escapeHTML(b.type)})
            </option>

            `
        )
        .join("");
}

/* ================= ADMISSION ================= */

document
.getElementById("admissionForm")
.addEventListener(
"submit",
function(e){

    e.preventDefault();

    const patientId =
        document
        .getElementById(
            "admissionPatient"
        )
        .value;

    const bedId =
        Number(
            document
            .getElementById(
                "admissionBed"
            )
            .value
        );

    const patient =
        patients.find(
            p => p.id === patientId
        );

    const bed =
        beds.find(
            b => b.id === bedId
        );

    if(!patient || !bed){

        alert(
            "Please select patient and available bed."
        );

        return;
    }

    if(bed.status !== "Available"){

        alert(
            "This bed is no longer available."
        );

        renderAll();

        return;
    }

    const alreadyAdmitted =
        admissions.find(
            a =>
                a.patientId === patientId &&
                a.status === "Admitted"
        );

    if(alreadyAdmitted){

        alert(
            "This patient is already admitted."
        );

        return;
    }

    const admission = {

        id:
            "ADM-" +
            Date.now(),

        patientId,

        patientName:
            patient.name,

        bedId,

        room:
            bed.room,

        bed:
            bed.bed,

        type:
            document
            .getElementById(
                "admissionType"
            )
            .value,

        date:
            document
            .getElementById(
                "admissionDate"
            )
            .value,

        status:"Admitted"

    };

    admissions.push(
        admission
    );

    bed.status =
        "Occupied";

    saveAll();

    this.reset();

    setTodayDefaults();

    renderAll();

    alert(
        "Patient admitted successfully."
    );

});

/* ================= ADMISSION TABLE ================= */

function renderAdmissions(){

    const tbody =
        document.getElementById(
            "admissionTable"
        );

    if(admissions.length === 0){

        tbody.innerHTML =
            `
            <tr>
                <td
                    colspan="7"
                    class="empty"
                >
                    No admission records.
                </td>
            </tr>
            `;

        return;
    }

    tbody.innerHTML =
        admissions
        .slice()
        .reverse()
        .map(
            a => `

            <tr>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(a.patientName)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(a.room)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(a.bed)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(a.type)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(a.date)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${statusBadge(a.status)}
                </td>

                <td>

                    ${
                        a.status === "Admitted"
                        ?
                        `
                        <button
                            class="btn btn-gray"
                            onclick="dischargePatient('${escapeHTML(a.id)}')"
                        >
                            Discharge
                        </button>
                        `
                        :
                        "Completed"
                    }

                </td>

            </tr>

            `
        )
        .join("");
}

/* ================= DISCHARGE ================= */

function dischargePatient(id){

    const admission =
        admissions.find(
            a => a.id === id
        );

    if(!admission) return;

    if(
        !confirm(
            "Discharge this patient?"
        )
    ){
        return;
    }

    admission.status =
        "Discharged";

    const bed =
        beds.find(
            b => b.id === admission.bedId
        );

    if(bed){

        bed.status =
            "Available";

    }

    saveAll();

    renderAll();

    alert(
        "Patient discharged and bed marked available."
    );
}

/* ================= DASHBOARD ================= */

function renderDashboard(){

    document.getElementById(
        "totalPatients"
    ).textContent =
        patients.length;

    document.getElementById(
        "todayAppointments"
    ).textContent =
        appointments.filter(
            a =>
                a.date === getToday()
        ).length;

    document.getElementById(
        "waitingPatients"
    ).textContent =
        appointments.filter(
            a =>
                a.status === "Waiting"
        ).length;

    document.getElementById(
        "availableBeds"
    ).textContent =
        beds.filter(
            b =>
                b.status === "Available"
        ).length;

    document.getElementById(
        "tokenCounter"
    ).textContent =
        tokenCounter;

    renderDashboardQueue();

    renderDashboardAlerts();

    renderDashboardAppointments();
}

/* ================= DASHBOARD QUEUE ================= */

function renderDashboardQueue(){

    const box =
        document.getElementById(
            "dashboardQueue"
        );

    const queue =
        appointments
        .filter(
            a =>
                a.date === getToday() &&
                (
                    a.status === "Waiting" ||
                    a.status === "Checked In"
                )
        )
        .sort(
            (a,b) =>
                Number(a.token) -
                Number(b.token)
        );

    if(queue.length === 0){

        box.innerHTML =
            `
            <div class="empty">
                No active patients in queue.
            </div>
            `;

        return;
    }

    box.innerHTML =
        queue
        .slice(0,5)
        .map(
            a => `

            <div class="queue-card">

                <div class="queue-number">
                    #${escapeHTML(a.token)}
                </div>

                <div class="queue-name">
                    ${escapeHTML(a.patientName)}
                </div>

                <div>
                    ${escapeHTML(a.doctor)}
                </div>

                <div style="margin-top:6px">
                    ${statusBadge(a.status)}
                </div>

            </div>

            `
        )
        .join("");
}

/* ================= ALERTS ================= */

function renderDashboardAlerts(){

    const box =
        document.getElementById(
            "dashboardAlerts"
        );

    const waiting =
        appointments.filter(
            a =>
                a.status === "Waiting"
        ).length;

    const availableBeds =
        beds.filter(
            b =>
                b.status === "Available"
        ).length;

    const cancelled =
        appointments.filter(
            a =>
                a.date === getToday() &&
                a.status === "Cancelled"
        ).length;

    let html = "";

    html += `
        <div class="alert info">
            <strong>Waiting Patients:</strong>
            ${waiting}
        </div>
    `;

    html += `
        <div class="alert success">
            <strong>Available Beds:</strong>
            ${availableBeds}
        </div>
    `;

    if(cancelled > 0){

        html += `
            <div class="alert danger">
                <strong>Cancelled Today:</strong>
                ${cancelled}
            </div>
        `;

    }else{

        html += `
            <div class="alert success">
                No appointment cancellation alert.
            </div>
        `;

    }

    box.innerHTML =
        html;
}

/* ================= DASHBOARD APPOINTMENTS ================= */

function renderDashboardAppointments(){

    const tbody =
        document.getElementById(
            "dashboardAppointments"
        );

    const today =
        appointments
        .filter(
            a =>
                a.date === getToday()
        )
        .sort(
            (a,b) =>
                a.time.localeCompare(
                    b.time
                )
        );

    if(today.length === 0){

        tbody.innerHTML =
            `
            <tr>
                <td
                    colspan="5"
                    class="empty"
                >
                    No appointments for today.
                </td>
            </tr>
            `;

        return;
    }

    tbody.innerHTML =
        today
        .slice(0,10)
        .map(
            a => `

            <tr>

                <td>
                    #${escapeHTML(a.token)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(a.patientName)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(a.doctor)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(a.time)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${statusBadge(a.status)}
                </td>

            </tr>

            `
        )
        .join("");
}

/* ================= DEFAULT DATES ================= */

function setTodayDefaults(){

    const today =
        getToday();

    const dateFields = [

        "appointmentDate",
        "admissionDate"

    ];

    dateFields.forEach(
        id => {

            const field =
                document.getElementById(
                    id
                );

            if(field){
                field.value =
                    today;
            }

        }
    );
}

);

/* ================= LOGOUT ================= */

function logout(){

    if(
        !confirm(
            "Do you want to logout?"
        )
    ){
        return;
    }

    localStorage.removeItem(
        "gjh_token"
    );

    localStorage.removeItem(
        "gjh_user"
    );

    window.location.replace(
        "login.html"
    );
}

/* ================= RENDER ALL ================= */

function renderAll(){

    renderDashboard();

    renderPatientDropdowns();

    renderPatientList();

    renderAppointments();

    renderQueue();

    renderBilling();

    renderBeds();

    renderAdmissions();

    renderEmergencies();

}

createDemoData();

loadStaff();

setTodayDefaults();

renderAll();

document.body.classList.remove(
    "locked"
);

</script>

</body>
</html>

const API = "http://localhost:5000/api/pharmacy";
const HOSPITAL_ID = "HOSP-TEST-001";

let medicines = [];
let sales = [];
let inventoryTransactions = [];
let selectedStockMedicineId = null;
let selectedEditMedicineId = null;
let prescriptions = [];
const CONSULTATION_API = "http://localhost:5000/api/consultations";


/* =========================================================
   HELPER
========================================================= */

function $(id) {
    return document.getElementById(id);
}

function money(value) {
    return "₹" + Number(value || 0).toFixed(2);
}

function formatDate(value) {
    if (!value) return "-";

    const date = new Date(value);

    if (isNaN(date.getTime())) {
        return value;
    }

    return date.toLocaleDateString("en-IN");
}

function formatDateTime(value) {
    if (!value) return "-";

    const date = new Date(value);

    if (isNaN(date.getTime())) {
        return value;
    }

    return date.toLocaleString("en-IN");
}

function escapeHtml(value) {
    return String(value ?? "")
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#039;");
}


/* =========================================================
   TOAST
========================================================= */

function showToast(message, type = "success") {

    const toast = $("toast");

    if (!toast) return;

    toast.textContent = message;

    toast.classList.remove(
        "show",
        "success",
        "error"
    );

    toast.classList.add(
        "show",
        type
    );

    setTimeout(() => {
        toast.classList.remove("show");
    }, 3000);
}


/* =========================================================
   API REQUEST
========================================================= */

async function apiRequest(url, options = {}) {

    const response = await fetch(url, {
        ...options,
        headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            ...(options.headers || {})
        }
    });

    let data = {};

    try {
        data = await response.json();
    } catch {
        data = {};
    }

    if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
            data.message ||
            `Server error: ${response.status}`
        );
    }

    return data;
}


/* =========================================================
   NORMALIZE MEDICINE
========================================================= */

function normalizeMedicine(medicine) {

    return {
        ...medicine,

        id: medicine.id,

        hospitalId:
            medicine.hospitalId ||
            HOSPITAL_ID,

        name:
            medicine.name || "",

        genericName:
            medicine.genericName || "",

        category:
            medicine.category || "",

        manufacturer:
            medicine.manufacturer || "",

        batchNumber:
            medicine.batchNumber ||
            medicine.batch ||
            "",

        expiryDate:
            medicine.expiryDate || "",

        purchasePrice:
            Number(
                medicine.purchasePrice || 0
            ),

        sellingPrice:
            Number(
                medicine.sellingPrice || 0
            ),

        stock:
            Number(
                medicine.stock || 0
            ),

        minimumStock:
            Number(
                medicine.minimumStock ??
                medicine.minStock ??
                0
            ),

        supplier:
            medicine.supplier || "",

        location:
            medicine.location ||
            medicine.rack ||
            "",

        status:
            medicine.status || "active"
    };
}


/* =========================================================
   LOAD MEDICINES
========================================================= */

async function loadMedicines() {

    try {

        const data = await apiRequest(
            `${API}?hospitalId=${encodeURIComponent(HOSPITAL_ID)}`
        );

        medicines =
            Array.isArray(data.medicines)
                ? data.medicines.map(normalizeMedicine)
                : [];

        updateDashboard();

        searchMedicines();

        renderInventory();

        populateMedicineDropdowns();

        renderDashboardSearch();

        renderAlerts();

        renderPrescriptionQueue();

        console.log(
            "Medicines loaded:",
            medicines
        );

    } catch (error) {

        console.error(
            "Medicine API Error:",
            error
        );

        showToast(
            "Medicine data load nahi ho raha",
            "error"
        );

        updateDashboard(true);
    }
}

async function loadPrescriptions() {

    try {

        const data =
            await apiRequest(
                `${CONSULTATION_API}/prescriptions?hospitalId=${encodeURIComponent(HOSPITAL_ID)}`
            );

        prescriptions =
            Array.isArray(data.prescriptions)
                ? data.prescriptions
                : [];

    } catch (error) {

        console.error(
            "Prescription API Error:",
            error
        );

        prescriptions = [];

        renderPrescriptionQueue();
    }

function prescriptionMedicineName(item) {

    if (typeof item === "string") {
        return item;
    }

    if (!item || typeof item !== "object") {
        return "Medicine";
    }

    return (
        item.medicineName ||
        item.name ||
        item.medicine ||
        item.drug ||
        "Medicine"
    );
}


function prescriptionMedicineQuantity(item) {

    if (!item || typeof item !== "object") {
        return 1;
    }

    return Number(
        item.quantity ||
        item.qty ||
        item.units ||
        1
    );
}


function prescriptionMedicinePrice(name) {

    const medicine =
        medicines.find(m =>
            m.name.toLowerCase() ===
                String(name).toLowerCase()
            ||
            m.genericName.toLowerCase() ===
                String(name).toLowerCase()
        );

    return medicine
        ? medicine.sellingPrice
        : 0;
}


/* =========================================================
   PRESCRIPTION QUEUE
========================================================= */

function renderPrescriptionQueue() {

    const container =
        $("prescriptionQueue");

    if (!container) return;

    if (!prescriptions.length) {

        container.innerHTML = `
            <div class="empty">
                💊 No pending doctor prescriptions found.
            </div>
        `;

        return;
    }

    container.innerHTML =
        prescriptions
            .map(rx => {

                const items =
                    Array.isArray(rx.prescription)
                        ? rx.prescription
                        : [];

                return `
                    <div
                        class="alert-item"
                        style="margin-bottom:12px;"
                    >

                        <div>

                            <strong>
                                ${escapeHtml(
                                    rx.patientName ||
                                    "Patient"
                                )}
                            </strong>

                            <br>

                            <small>
                                Patient ID:
                                ${escapeHtml(
                                    rx.patientId || "-"
                                )}
                            </small>

                            <br>

                            <small>
                                Doctor:
                                ${escapeHtml(
                                    rx.doctorName || "-"
                                )}
                            </small>

                            ${
                                rx.diagnosis
                                    ? `
                                        <br>
                                        <small>
                                            Diagnosis:
                                            ${escapeHtml(
                                                rx.diagnosis
                                            )}
                                        </small>
                                      `
                                    : ""
                            }

                        </div>


                        <div
                            style="
                                margin-top:10px;
                            "
                        >

                            ${
                                items
                                    .map(
                                        (
                                            item,
                                            index
                                        ) => {

                                            const name =
                                                prescriptionMedicineName(
                                                    item
                                                );

                                            const qty =
                                                prescriptionMedicineQuantity(
                                                    item
                                                );

                                            const medicine =
                                                medicines.find(
                                                    m =>
                                                        m.name
                                                            .toLowerCase() ===
                                                        name.toLowerCase()
                                                        ||
                                                        m.genericName
                                                            .toLowerCase() ===
                                                        name.toLowerCase()
                                                );

                                            return `
                                                <div
                                                    style="
                                                        display:flex;
                                                        justify-content:space-between;
                                                        gap:10px;
                                                        align-items:center;
                                                        padding:8px 0;
                                                        border-top:1px solid #eee;
                                                    "
                                                >

                                                    <span>

                                                        <strong>
                                                            ${escapeHtml(
                                                                name
                                                            )}
                                                        </strong>

                                                        × ${qty}

                                                        ${
                                                            medicine
                                                                ? `
                                                                    <small>
                                                                        (Stock:
                                                                        ${medicine.stock})
                                                                    </small>
                                                                  `
                                                                : `
                                                                    <small>
                                                                        (Not matched)
                                                                    </small>
                                                                  `
                                                        }

                                                    </span>


                                                    <button
                                                        class="btn btn-primary"
                                                        onclick="
                                                            usePrescriptionItem(
                                                                ${prescriptions.indexOf(rx)},
                                                                ${index}
                                                            )
                                                        "
                                                    >
                                                        Dispense
                                                    </button>

                                                </div>
                                            `;
                                        }
                                    )
                                    .join("")
                            }

                        </div>

                    </div>
                `;
            })
            .join("");
}/* =========================================================
   USE PRESCRIPTION ITEM
========================================================= */

function usePrescriptionItem(rxIndex, itemIndex) {

    const rx = prescriptions[rxIndex];

    if (!rx || !Array.isArray(rx.prescription)) {
        showToast("Prescription nahi mili", "error");
        return;
    }

    const item = rx.prescription[itemIndex];

    const name = prescriptionMedicineName(item);

    const prescriptionName =
        String(name || "").trim().toLowerCase();

    const medicine = medicines.find(medicine => {

        const medicineName =
            String(medicine.name || "")
                .trim()
                .toLowerCase();

        const genericName =
            String(medicine.genericName || "")
                .trim()
                .toLowerCase();

        return (
            medicineName === prescriptionName ||
            genericName === prescriptionName
        );
    });

    if (!medicine) {

        showToast(
            `Prescription medicine "${name}" inventory me nahi mili`,
            "error"
        );

        return;
    }

    const qty =
        prescriptionMedicineQuantity(item);

    if (!qty || qty <= 0) {

        showToast(
            "Prescription quantity valid nahi hai",
            "error"
        );

        return;
    }

    if (qty > Number(medicine.stock || 0)) {

        showToast(
            `Sirf ${medicine.stock} units ${medicine.name} ki available hain`,
            "error"
        );

        return;
    }

    if ($("dispensePatient")) {
        $("dispensePatient").value =
            rx.patientName || "";
    }

    if ($("dispensePatientId")) {
        $("dispensePatientId").value =
            rx.patientId || "";
    }

    if ($("dispenseMedicine")) {

        $("dispenseMedicine").value =
            medicine.id;

        /*
         * Prescription wali exact medicine ID
         * save kar rahe hain.
         */
        $("dispenseMedicine").dataset.prescriptionMedicineId =
            medicine.id;
    }

    if ($("dispenseQuantity")) {
        $("dispenseQuantity").value =
            qty;
    }

    if ($("prescriptionRef")) {
        $("prescriptionRef").value =
            rx.consultationId ||
            rx.appointmentId ||
            "";
    }

    showPage("dispense");

    showToast(
        `${medicine.name} prescription ke according load ho gayi`
    );
}

/* =========================================================
   DASHBOARD
========================================================= */

async function updateDashboard(error = false) {

    if (error) {

        if ($("totalMedicines"))
            $("totalMedicines").textContent = "—";

        if ($("inventoryCount"))
            $("inventoryCount").textContent = "—";

        if ($("lowStockCount"))
            $("lowStockCount").textContent = "—";

        if ($("dispensedCount"))
            $("dispensedCount").textContent = "—";

        if ($("inventoryValue"))
            $("inventoryValue").textContent = "—";

        if ($("expiringCount"))
            $("expiringCount").textContent = "—";

        if ($("expiredCount"))
            $("expiredCount").textContent = "—";

        if ($("todaySalesCount"))
            $("todaySalesCount").textContent = "—";

        if ($("todaySalesAmount"))
            $("todaySalesAmount").textContent = "—";

        return;
    }


    try {

        const data = await apiRequest(
            `${API}/summary?hospitalId=${encodeURIComponent(HOSPITAL_ID)}`
        );

        const summary = data.summary || {};


        if ($("totalMedicines"))
            $("totalMedicines").textContent =
                Number(summary.totalMedicines || 0);


        if ($("inventoryCount"))
            $("inventoryCount").textContent =
                Number(summary.totalStockUnits || 0);


        if ($("lowStockCount"))
            $("lowStockCount").textContent =
                Number(summary.lowStockCount || 0);


        if ($("inventoryValue"))
            $("inventoryValue").textContent =
                money(summary.inventoryValue || 0);


        if ($("expiringCount"))
            $("expiringCount").textContent =
                Number(summary.expiringCount || 0);


        if ($("expiredCount"))
            $("expiredCount").textContent =
                Number(summary.expiredCount || 0);


        if ($("todaySalesCount"))
            $("todaySalesCount").textContent =
                Number(summary.salesTodayCount || 0);


        if ($("todaySalesAmount"))
            $("todaySalesAmount").textContent =
                money(summary.todaySalesAmount || 0);


        /*
         * Existing card agar dispensedCount use karti hai
         * to today's sales quantity ke liye fallback
         */

        if ($("dispensedCount")) {

            const totalDispensed =
                sales.reduce(
                    (total, sale) =>
                        total +
                        Number(sale.quantity || 0),
                    0
                );

            $("dispensedCount").textContent =
                totalDispensed;
        }


        console.log(
            "✓ Pharmacy dashboard summary loaded:",
            summary
        );


    } catch (error) {

        console.error(
            "Dashboard summary API error:",
            error
        );

        /*
         * Backend summary fail ho to
         * existing local medicines data se dashboard
         * completely blank nahi hoga.
         */

        const totalMedicines =
            medicines.length;


        const inventoryCount =
            medicines.reduce(
                (total, medicine) =>
                    total +
                    Number(medicine.stock || 0),
                0
            );


        const lowStockCount =
            medicines.filter(
                medicine =>
                    Number(medicine.stock || 0) <=
                    Number(medicine.minimumStock || 0)
            ).length;


        if ($("totalMedicines"))
            $("totalMedicines").textContent =
                totalMedicines;


        if ($("inventoryCount"))
            $("inventoryCount").textContent =
                inventoryCount;


        if ($("lowStockCount"))
            $("lowStockCount").textContent =
                lowStockCount;


        if ($("dispensedCount"))
            $("dispensedCount").textContent =
                sales.reduce(
                    (total, sale) =>
                        total +
                        Number(sale.quantity || 0),
                    0
                );


        if ($("inventoryValue"))
            $("inventoryValue").textContent =
                money(
                    medicines.reduce(
                        (total, medicine) =>
                            total +
                            (
                                Number(
                                    medicine.purchasePrice || 0
                                ) *
                                Number(
                                    medicine.stock || 0
                                )
                            ),
                        0
                    )
                );
    }
}

function renderDashboardSearch() {

    const container =
        $("dashboardResults");

    if (!container) return;

    const search =
        ($("dashboardSearch")?.value || "")
            .trim()
            .toLowerCase();

    if (!search) {

        container.innerHTML = `
            <div class="empty">

                <div class="empty-icon">
                    💊
                </div>

                Search for a medicine

            </div>
        `;

        return;
    }

    const results =
        medicines.filter(
            medicine =>

                medicine.name
                    .toLowerCase()
                    .includes(search)

                ||

                medicine.genericName
                    .toLowerCase()
                    .includes(search)

                ||

                medicine.category
                    .toLowerCase()
                    .includes(search)
        );

    if (!results.length) {

        container.innerHTML = `
            <div class="empty">
                No medicine found.
            </div>
        `;

        return;
    }

    container.innerHTML =
        results
            .slice(0, 10)
            .map(
                medicine => `

                    <div
                        class="medicine-card"
                        style="margin-bottom:10px;"
                        onclick="
                            openMedicineModal(
                                '${medicine.id}'
                            )
                        "
                    >

                        <h4>
                            ${escapeHtml(
                                medicine.name
                            )}
                        </h4>

                        <div
                            class="medicine-meta"
                        >

                            Generic:
                            ${escapeHtml(
                                medicine.genericName ||
                                "-"
                            )}

                            <br>

                            Stock:
                            <strong>
                                ${medicine.stock}
                            </strong>

                        </div>

                        <div
                            class="medicine-price"
                        >
                            ${money(
                                medicine.sellingPrice
                            )}
                        </div>

                    </div>

                `
            )
            .join("");
}


/* =========================================================
   MEDICINES SEARCH
========================================================= */

function searchMedicines() {

    const container =
        $("medicineResults");

    if (!container) return;

    const search =
        ($("medicineSearch")?.value || "")
            .trim()
            .toLowerCase();

    const category =
        $("categoryFilter")?.value || "";

    const filtered =
        medicines.filter(
            medicine => {

                const matchesSearch =
                    !search
                    ||

                    medicine.name
                        .toLowerCase()
                        .includes(search)

                    ||

                    medicine.genericName
                        .toLowerCase()
                        .includes(search)

                    ||

                    medicine.category
                        .toLowerCase()
                        .includes(search)

                    ||

                    medicine.batchNumber
                        .toLowerCase()
                        .includes(search);

                const matchesCategory =
                    !category
                    ||
                    medicine.category ===
                        category;

                return (
                    matchesSearch &&
                    matchesCategory
                );
            }
        );

    if (!filtered.length) {

        container.innerHTML = `
            <div class="empty">

                <div class="empty-icon">
                    💊
                </div>

                No medicines found.

            </div>
        `;

        return;
    }

    container.innerHTML =
        filtered
            .map(
                medicine => {

                    const lowStock =
                        medicine.stock <=
                        medicine.minimumStock;

                    const expired =
                        isExpired(
                            medicine.expiryDate
                        );

                    return `
                        <div
                            class="medicine-card"
                            onclick="
                                openMedicineModal(
                                    '${medicine.id}'
                                )
                            "
                            style="
                                cursor:pointer;
                            "
                        >

                            <h4>
                                ${escapeHtml(
                                    medicine.name
                                )}
                            </h4>

                            <div
                                class="medicine-meta"
                            >

                                Generic:
                                ${escapeHtml(
                                    medicine.genericName ||
                                    "-"
                                )}

                                <br>

                                Category:
                                ${escapeHtml(
                                    medicine.category ||
                                    "-"
                                )}

                                <br>

                                Batch:
                                ${escapeHtml(
                                    medicine.batchNumber ||
                                    "-"
                                )}

                                <br>

                                Expiry:
                                ${formatDate(
                                    medicine.expiryDate
                                )}

                                <br>

                                Stock:
                                <strong>
                                    ${medicine.stock}
                                </strong>

                            </div>

                            <div
                                class="medicine-price"
                            >
                                ${money(
                                    medicine.sellingPrice
                                )}
                            </div>

                            ${
                                expired
                                    ? `
                                        <span
                                            class="
                                                badge
                                                badge-danger
                                            "
                                            style="
                                                margin-top:10px;
                                            "
                                        >
                                            ⚠ Expired
                                        </span>
                                      `
                                    :
                                    lowStock
                                    ? `
                                        <span
                                            class="
                                                badge
                                                badge-danger
                                            "
                                            style="
                                                margin-top:10px;
                                            "
                                        >
                                            ⚠ Low Stock
                                        </span>
                                      `
                                    : `
                                        <span
                                            class="
                                                badge
                                                badge-success
                                            "
                                            style="
                                                margin-top:10px;
                                            "
                                        >
                                            ✓ Available
                                        </span>
                                      `
                            }

                        </div>
                    `;
                }
            )
            .join("");
}


/* =========================================================
   INVENTORY
========================================================= */

function renderInventory() {

    const table =
        $("inventoryTable");

    if (!table) return;

    const search =
        ($("inventorySearch")?.value || "")
            .trim()
            .toLowerCase();

    const filtered =
        medicines.filter(
            medicine => {

                if (!search) {
                    return true;
                }

                return (
                    medicine.name
                        .toLowerCase()
                        .includes(search)

                    ||

                    medicine.batchNumber
                        .toLowerCase()
                        .includes(search)

                    ||

                    medicine.category
                        .toLowerCase()
                        .includes(search)

                    ||

                    medicine.location
                        .toLowerCase()
                        .includes(search)
                );
            }
        );

    if (!filtered.length) {

        table.innerHTML = `
            <tr>

                <td
                    colspan="8"
                    style="
                        text-align:center;
                        padding:25px;
                    "
                >
                    No inventory items found.
                </td>

            </tr>
        `;

        return;
    }

    table.innerHTML =
        filtered
            .map(
                medicine => {

                    const lowStock =
                        medicine.stock <=
                        medicine.minimumStock;

                    const expired =
                        isExpired(
                            medicine.expiryDate
                        );

                  
                }
            )
            .join("");
}
