<script>

/* =========================
   AUTHENTICATION
========================= */

const token = localStorage.getItem("gjh_token");

if(!token){
    window.location.href="login.html";
}


async function verifyAccess(){

    try{

        const response = await fetch(
            "/api/private/nurse",
            {
                headers:{
                    Authorization:"Bearer "+token
                }
            }
        );

        if(!response.ok){

            localStorage.removeItem("gjh_token");
            localStorage.removeItem("gjh_user");

            window.location.href="login.html";

            return;
        }

        const data = await response.json();

        if(data.user){

            document.getElementById("nurseUser").textContent =
                data.user.name || "Nurse Staff";

            document.getElementById("avatar").textContent =
                (data.user.name || "N").charAt(0).toUpperCase();

        }

    }catch(error){

        console.log(error);

    }

}

verifyAccess();


function logout(){

    localStorage.removeItem("gjh_token");
    localStorage.removeItem("gjh_user");

    window.location.href="login.html";

}


/* =========================
   DATA
========================= */

let patients =
    JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("gjh_nurse_patients")) || [];

let vitals =
    JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("gjh_nurse_vitals")) || [];

let medications =
    JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("gjh_nurse_medications")) || [];

let tasks =
    JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("gjh_nurse_tasks")) || [];

let rounds =
    JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("gjh_nurse_rounds")) || [];

let handovers =
    JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("gjh_nurse_handovers")) || [];


/* =========================
   STORAGE
========================= */

function saveData(){

    localStorage.setItem(
        "gjh_nurse_patients",
        JSON.stringify(patients)
    );

    localStorage.setItem(
        "gjh_nurse_vitals",
        JSON.stringify(vitals)
    );

    localStorage.setItem(
        "gjh_nurse_medications",
        JSON.stringify(medications)
    );

    localStorage.setItem(
        "gjh_nurse_tasks",
        JSON.stringify(tasks)
    );

    localStorage.setItem(
        "gjh_nurse_rounds",
        JSON.stringify(rounds)
    );

    localStorage.setItem(
        "gjh_nurse_handovers",
        JSON.stringify(handovers)
    );

}


/* =========================
   NAVIGATION
========================= */

function showPage(page,button){

    document.querySelectorAll(".page").forEach(p=>{
        p.classList.remove("active");
    });

    document.getElementById(page).classList.add("active");

    document.querySelectorAll(".nav-btn").forEach(b=>{
        b.classList.remove("active");
    });

    if(button){
        button.classList.add("active");
    }

    if(page==="dashboard") renderDashboard();
    if(page==="patients") renderPatients();
    if(page==="vitals") renderVitals();
    if(page==="medications") renderMedications();
    if(page==="tasks") renderTasks();
    if(page==="rounds") renderRounds();
    if(page==="alerts") renderAlerts();
    if(page==="handover") renderHandovers();

}


/* =========================
   PATIENT MODAL
========================= */

function openPatientModal(){

    document.getElementById("patientModal")
        .classList.add("show");

}


function addPatient(){

    const name =
        document.getElementById("patientName").value.trim();

    const id =
        document.getElementById("patientId").value.trim();

    const age =
        document.getElementById("patientAge").value;

    const ward =
        document.getElementById("patientWard").value.trim();

    const bed =
        document.getElementById("patientBed").value.trim();

    const doctor =
        document.getElementById("patientDoctor").value.trim();

    const condition =
        document.getElementById("patientCondition").value.trim();


    if(!name || !id || !ward || !bed){

        alert("Please fill required patient fields.");

        return;

    }


    patients.unshift({

        id,

        name,

        age,

        ward,

        bed,

        doctor,

        condition,

        createdAt:new Date().toLocaleString()

    });


    saveData();

    closeModal("patientModal");

    document.getElementById("patientName").value="";
    document.getElementById("patientId").value="";
    document.getElementById("patientAge").value="";
    document.getElementById("patientWard").value="";
    document.getElementById("patientBed").value="";
    document.getElementById("patientDoctor").value="";
    document.getElementById("patientCondition").value="";


    renderPatients();
    renderDashboard();

}


/* =========================
   PATIENT TABLE
========================= */

function renderPatients(){

    const query =
        (document.getElementById("patientSearch")?.value || "")
        .toLowerCase();


    const data =
        patients.filter(p=>
            `${p.id} ${p.name} ${p.ward} ${p.bed} ${p.doctor}`
            .toLowerCase()
            .includes(query)
        );


    const tbody =
        document.getElementById("patientsTable");


    if(!data.length){

        tbody.innerHTML=`

            <tr>

                <td colspan="8">

                    <div class="empty">
                        No patients found.
                    </div>

                </td>

            </tr>

        `;

        return;

    }


    tbody.innerHTML =
        data.map(p=>`

            <tr>

                <td>
                    <strong>${p.id}</strong>
                </td>

                <td>${p.name}</td>

                <td>${p.age || "-"}</td>

                <td>${p.ward}</td>

                <td>${p.bed}</td>

                <td>${p.doctor || "-"}</td>

                <td>${p.condition || "-"}</td>

                <td>

                    <button
                        class="small-btn"
                        onclick="viewPatient('${p.id}')"
                    >
                        View
                    </button>

                </td>

            </tr>

        `).join("");

}


function viewPatient(id){

    const p =
        patients.find(x=>x.id===id);

    if(!p) return;

    alert(
        "Patient ID: "+p.id+
        "\nName: "+p.name+
        "\nAge: "+(p.age||"-")+
        "\nWard: "+p.ward+
        "\nBed: "+p.bed+
        "\nDoctor: "+(p.doctor||"-")+
        "\nCondition: "+(p.condition||"-")
    );

}


/* =========================
   PATIENT SELECTS
========================= */

function populatePatientSelects(){

    const selects=[
        "vitalPatient",
        "medPatient",
        "taskPatient",
        "roundPatient",
        "handoverPatient"
    ];


    selects.forEach(id=>{

        const select =
            document.getElementById(id);

        if(!select) return;

        select.innerHTML =
            `<option value="">Select patient</option>`+
            patients.map(p=>`

                <option value="${p.id}">
                    ${p.name} (${p.id})
                </option>

            `).join("");

    });

}


/* =========================
   VITALS
========================= */

function openVitalsModal(){

    populatePatientSelects();

    document.getElementById("vitalsModal")
        .classList.add("show");

}


function saveVitals(){

    const patientId =
        document.getElementById("vitalPatient").value;

    const patient =
        patients.find(p=>p.id===patientId);

    if(!patient){

        alert("Please select patient.");

        return;

    }


    const record={

        id:"VIT-"+Date.now(),

        patientId,

        patient:patient.name,

        temperature:
            document.getElementById("temperature").value.trim(),

        pulse:
            document.getElementById("pulse").value.trim(),

        bp:
            document.getElementById("bp").value.trim(),

        spo2:
            document.getElementById("spo2").value.trim(),

        respiration:
            document.getElementById("respiration").value.trim(),

        observation:
            document.getElementById("vitalObservation").value.trim(),

        time:new Date().toLocaleString()

    };


    vitals.unshift(record);

    saveData();

    closeModal("vitalsModal");

    renderVitals();
    renderDashboard();
    generateAlerts();

    alert("Vitals recorded successfully.");

}


function renderVitals(){

    const query =
        (document.getElementById("vitalSearch")?.value || "")
        .toLowerCase();


    const data =
        vitals.filter(v=>
            `${v.patient} ${v.patientId}`
            .toLowerCase()
            .includes(query)
        );


    const tbody =
        document.getElementById("vitalsTable");


    if(!data.length){

        tbody.innerHTML=`

            <tr>
                <td colspan="8">
                    <div class="empty">
                        No vitals records found.
                    </div>
                </td>
            </tr>

        `;

        return;

    }


    tbody.innerHTML =
        data.map(v=>`

            <tr>

                <td>${v.patient}</td>

                <td>${v.temperature || "-"}</td>

                <td>${v.pulse || "-"}</td>

                <td>${v.bp || "-"}</td>

                <td>${v.spo2 || "-"}</td>

                <td>${v.respiration || "-"}</td>

                <td>${v.time}</td>

                <td>

                    <span class="badge normal">
                        Recorded
                    </span>

                </td>

            </tr>

        `).join("");

}


/* =========================
   MEDICATIONS
========================= */

function openMedicationModal(){

    populatePatientSelects();

    document.getElementById("medicationModal")
        .classList.add("show");

}


function saveMedication(){

    const patientId =
        document.getElementById("medPatient").value;

    const patient =
        patients.find(p=>p.id===patientId);

    const medicine =
        document.getElementById("medicineName")
        .value.trim();

    if(!patient || !medicine){

        alert("Please select patient and medicine.");

        return;

    }


    medications.unshift({

        id:"MED-"+Date.now(),

        patientId,

        patient:patient.name,

        medicine,

        schedule:
            document.getElementById("medicineSchedule")
            .value.trim(),

        status:
            document.getElementById("medicineStatus").value,

        notes:
            document.getElementById("medicineNotes")
            .value.trim(),

        time:new Date().toLocaleString()

    });


    saveData();

    closeModal("medicationModal");

    renderMedications();
    renderDashboard();

    alert("Medication record saved.");

}


function renderMedications(){

    const tbody =
        document.getElementById("medicationTable");


    if(!medications.length){

        tbody.innerHTML=`

            <tr>

                <td colspan="6">

                    <div class="empty">
                        No medication records found.
                    </div>

                </td>

            </tr>

        `;

        return;

    }


    tbody.innerHTML =
        medications.map(m=>`

            <tr>

                <td>${m.patient}</td>

                <td>${m.medicine}</td>

                <td>${m.schedule || "-"}</td>

                <td>

                    <span class="badge ${
                        m.status==="Administered"
                        ?"completed"
                        :"pending"
                    }">

                        ${m.status}

                    </span>

                </td>

                <td>${m.time}</td>

                <td>${m.notes || "-"}</td>

            </tr>

        `).join("");

}


/* =========================
   TASKS
========================= */

function openTaskModal(){

    populatePatientSelects();

    document.getElementById("taskModal")
        .classList.add("show");

}


function saveTask(){

    const patientId =
        document.getElementById("taskPatient").value;

    const patient =
        patients.find(p=>p.id===patientId);

    const task =
        document.getElementById("taskName")
        .value.trim();


    if(!patient || !task){

        alert("Please select patient and task.");

        return;

    }


    tasks.unshift({

        id:"TASK-"+Date.now(),

        patientId,

        patient:patient.name,

        task,

        priority:
            document.getElementById("taskPriority").value,

        status:
            document.getElementById("taskStatus").value,

        assignedAt:new Date().toLocaleString()

    });


    saveData();

    closeModal("taskModal");

    renderTasks();
    renderDashboard();

    alert("Care task added.");

}


function renderTasks(){

    const filter =
        document.getElementById("taskFilter")?.value || "";


    const data =
        tasks.filter(t=>
            !filter || t.status===filter
        );


    const tbody =
        document.getElementById("tasksTable");


    if(!data.length){

        tbody.innerHTML=`

            <tr>

                <td colspan="6">

                    <div class="empty">
                        No care tasks found.
                    </div>

                </td>

            </tr>

        `;

        return;

    }


    tbody.innerHTML =
        data.map(t=>`

            <tr>

                <td>${t.patient}</td>

                <td>${t.task}</td>

                <td>

                    <span class="badge ${
                        t.priority==="Urgent"
                        ?"critical"
                        :"pending"
                    }">

                        ${t.priority}

                    </span>

                </td>

                <td>

                    <span class="badge ${
                        t.status==="Completed"
                        ?"completed"
                        :t.status==="In Progress"
                        ?"progress"
                        :"pending"
                    }">

                        ${t.status}

                    </span>

                </td>

                <td>${t.assignedAt}</td>

                <td>

                    ${
                        t.status!=="Completed"
                        ?`
                        <button
                            class="small-btn green"
                            onclick="completeTask('${t.id}')"
                        >
                            Complete
                        </button>
                        `
                        :"Done"
                    }

                </td>

            </tr>

        `).join("");

}


function completeTask(id){

    const task =
        tasks.find(t=>t.id===id);

    if(!task) return;

    task.status="Completed";

    saveData();

    renderTasks();
    renderDashboard();

}

   WARD ROUNDS

function openRoundModal(){

    populatePatientSelects();

    document.getElementById("roundModal")
        .classList.add("show");

}


function saveRound(){

    const patientId =
        document.getElementById("roundPatient").value;

    const patient =
        patients.find(p=>p.id===patientId);

    const observation =
        document.getElementById("roundObservation")
        .value.trim();

    if(!patient || !observation){

    rounds.unshift({

        id:"ROUND-"+Date.now(),

        patientId,

        patient:patient.name,

        observation,

            document.getElementById("roundAction")

        time:new Date().toLocaleString()

function renderRounds(){

    const box =
        document.getElementById("roundsList");


    if(!rounds.length){

        box.innerHTML=
            `<div class="empty">No ward round notes yet.</div>`;

        return;

    }


    box.innerHTML =

                    <strong>Observation:</strong>
                    ${r.observation}
                </p>

                <p>
                    <strong>Action / Follow-up:</strong>

                <p>
                    <strong>Recorded:</strong>
                    ${r.time}
                </p>

            </div>

        `).join("");

}


/* =========================
   ALERTS
========================= */

let generatedAlerts=[];


function generateAlerts(){

    generatedAlerts=[];


    vitals.forEach(v=>{

        const text =
            `${v.temperature} ${v.pulse} ${v.bp} ${v.spo2}`
            .toLowerCase();


        if(
            text.includes("critical") ||
            text.includes("urgent")
        ){

            generatedAlerts.push({

                patient:v.patient,

                message:
                    "Vital record contains an urgent/critical note.",

                time:v.time

            });

        }

    });


    tasks
        .filter(t=>t.priority==="Urgent" && t.status!=="Completed")
        .forEach(t=>{

            generatedAlerts.push({

                patient:t.patient,

                message:
                    `Urgent care task pending: ${t.task}`,

                time:t.assignedAt

            });

        });

}


function renderAlerts(){

    generateAlerts();


    const box =
        document.getElementById("alertsList");


    if(!generatedAlerts.length){

        box.innerHTML=`

            <div class="empty">
                No active nursing alerts.
            </div>

        `;

        return;

    }


    box.innerHTML =
        generatedAlerts.map(a=>`

            <div class="alert red">

                <strong>${a.patient}</strong>

                <br>

                ${a.message}

                <br>

                <small>${a.time}</small>

            </div>

        `).join("");

}

   HANDOVER
========================= */

function openHandoverModal(){

    populatePatientSelects();

    document.getElementById("handoverModal")
        .classList.add("show");

}


function saveHandover(){

    const patientId =

    const notes =
        document.getElementById("handoverNotes")
        .value.trim();

    if(!patient || !notes){

        alert("Please select patient and enter handover information.");

        return;

    }


    handovers.unshift({

        id:"HAND-"+Date.now(),

        patientId,

        patient:patient.name,

        shift:
            document.getElementById("handoverShift").value,

        notes,

        time:new Date().toLocaleString()

    });


    saveData();

    closeModal("handoverModal");

    renderHandovers();

    alert("Shift handover saved.");

}


function renderHandovers(){

    const box =
        document.getElementById("handoverList");


    if(!handovers.length){

        box.innerHTML=
            `<div class="empty">
                No shift handover records yet.
            </div>`;

        return;

    }


    box.innerHTML =
        handovers.map(h=>`

            <div class="handover-box">

                <strong>${h.patient}</strong>

                <p style="margin-top:7px">
                    Shift: ${h.shift}
                </p>

                <p style="margin-top:7px">
                    ${h.notes}
                </p>

                <small>
                    ${h.time}
                </small>

            </div>

        `).join("");

}


/* =========================
   DASHBOARD
========================= */

function renderDashboard(){

    generateAlerts();


    document.getElementById("totalPatients")
        .textContent=patients.length;

    document.getElementById("vitalsCount")
        .textContent=vitals.length;

    document.getElementById("medCount")
        .textContent=medications.length;

    document.getElementById("pendingTasks")
        .textContent=
            tasks.filter(t=>t.status!=="Completed").length;

    document.getElementById("alertCount")
        .textContent=generatedAlerts.length;


    const patientBox =
        document.getElementById("dashboardPatients");


    if(!patients.length){

        patientBox.innerHTML=
            `<div class="empty">
                No patients assigned.
            </div>`;

    }else{

        patientBox.innerHTML =
            patients.slice(0,5).map(p=>`

                <div class="patient-card"
                     style="margin-bottom:8px">

                    <h3>${p.name}</h3>

                    <p>
                        ID: ${p.id}
                        • Ward: ${p.ward}
                        • Bed: ${p.bed}
                    </p>

                    <p>
                        Doctor: ${p.doctor || "-"}
                    </p>

                </div>

            `).join("");

    }


    const alertBox =
        document.getElementById("dashboardAlerts");


    if(!generatedAlerts.length){

        alertBox.innerHTML=
            `<div class="empty">
                No active alerts.
            </div>`;

    }else{

        alertBox.innerHTML =
            generatedAlerts.slice(0,5).map(a=>`

                <div class="alert red">

                    <strong>${a.patient}</strong>

                    <br>

                    ${a.message}

                </div>

            `).join("");

    }

}


/* =========================
   MODALS
========================= */

function closeModal(id){

    document.getElementById(id)
        .classList.remove("show");

}


document.querySelectorAll(".modal").forEach(modal=>{

    modal.addEventListener("click",e=>{

        if(e.target===modal){

            modal.classList.remove("show");

        }

    });

});


/* =========================
   INITIALIZATION
========================= */

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",()=>{

    populatePatientSelects();

    renderDashboard();

    renderPatients();

    renderVitals();

    renderMedications();

    renderTasks();

    renderRounds();

    renderAlerts();

    renderHandovers();

});

</script>

</body>
</html>

<script>

document.documentElement.style.visibility="hidden";

async function verifyBedsAccess(){

    const token=localStorage.getItem("gjh_token");

    if(!token){
        window.location.replace("login.html");
        return;
    }

    try{

        const response=await fetch(
            "/api/private/beds",
            {
                headers:{
                    "Authorization":"Bearer "+token
                }
            }
        );

        const data=await response.json();

        if(
            !response.ok ||
            !data.success ||
            !data.user ||
            data.user.role!=="beds"
        ){

            localStorage.removeItem("gjh_token");
            localStorage.removeItem("gjh_user");

            alert(
                "Access denied. Only authorized bed management staff can open this panel."
            );

            window.location.replace("login.html");
            return;
        }

        document.documentElement.style.visibility="visible";

    }catch(error){

        alert("Unable to verify beds login.");
        window.location.replace("login.html");

    }

}

verifyBedsAccess();

</script>

<script>

let beds=
JSON.parse(
    localStorage.getItem(
        "gjh_beds_data"
    ) || "[]"
);

let bedHistory=
JSON.parse(
    localStorage.getItem(
        "gjh_beds_history"
    ) || "[]"
);


function saveData(){

    localStorage.setItem(
        "gjh_beds_data",
        JSON.stringify(beds)
    );

    localStorage.setItem(
        "gjh_beds_history",
        JSON.stringify(bedHistory)
    );

}


function escapeHTML(value){

    return String(value ?? "")
    .replace(/&/g,"&amp;")
    .replace(/</g,"&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g,"&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g,"&quot;")
    .replace(/'/g,"&#039;");

}

function statusBadge(status){

    let cls="available";

    if(status==="Occupied"){
        cls="occupied";
    }

    if(status==="Reserved"){
        cls="reserved";
    }

    if(status==="Cleaning"){
        cls="cleaning";
    }

    if(status==="Maintenance"){
        cls="maintenance";
    }

    return `
        <span class="badge ${cls}">
            ${escapeHTML(status)}
        </span>
    `;

}


function showPage(id,link){

    document
    .querySelectorAll(".page")
    .forEach(
        p=>p.classList.remove("active")
    );

    document
    .querySelectorAll(".sidebar a")
    .forEach(
        a=>a.classList.remove("active")
    );

    document
    .getElementById(id)
    .classList.add("active");

    link.classList.add("active");

    if(id==="dashboard"){
        renderDashboard();
    }

    if(id==="beds"){
        renderBeds();
    }

    if(id==="wards"){
        renderWards();
    }

    if(id==="occupancy"){
        renderOccupancy();
    }

    if(id==="emergency"){
        renderEmergency();
    }

    if(id==="history"){
        renderHistory();
    }

}


function renderDashboard(){

    const total=beds.length;

    const available=
    beds.filter(
        b=>b.status==="Available"
    ).length;

    const occupied=
    beds.filter(
        b=>b.status==="Occupied"
    ).length;

    const reserved=
    beds.filter(
        b=>b.status==="Reserved"
    ).length;

    const cleaning=
    beds.filter(
        b=>b.status==="Cleaning"
    ).length;

    document.getElementById("totalBeds")
    .textContent=total;

    document.getElementById("availableCount")
    .textContent=available;

    document.getElementById("occupiedCount")
    .textContent=occupied;

    document.getElementById("reservedCount")
    .textContent=reserved;

    document.getElementById("cleaningCount")
    .textContent=cleaning;

    const alerts=[];

    if(available===0){

        alerts.push(`
            <div class="alert danger-alert">
                <strong>Critical:</strong>
                No beds are currently available.
            </div>
        `);

    }

    if(cleaning>0){

        alerts.push(`
            <div class="alert">
                <strong>Cleaning Required:</strong>
                ${cleaning} bed(s) waiting for cleaning.
            </div>
        `);

    }

    if(
        beds.filter(
            b=>b.status==="Maintenance"
        ).length>0
    ){

        alerts.push(`
            <div class="alert">
                <strong>Maintenance:</strong>
                Some beds are under maintenance.
            </div>
        `);

    }

    if(alerts.length===0){

        alerts.push(`
            <div class="alert success-alert">
                All bed management operations are normal.
            </div>
        `);

    }

    document.getElementById(
        "dashboardAlerts"
    ).innerHTML=alerts.join("");

    renderDashboardWards();

}


function getWards(){

    return [
        ...new Set(
            beds.map(
                b=>b.room
            )
        )
    ];

}


function renderDashboardWards(){

    const box=
    document.getElementById(
        "dashboardWards"
    );

    const wards=getWards();

    box.innerHTML=
    wards.map(
        ward=>{

            const list=
            beds.filter(
                b=>b.room===ward
            );

            const occupied=
            list.filter(
                b=>b.status==="Occupied"
            ).length;

            const percent=
            list.length
            ?
            Math.round(
                occupied/list.length*100
            )
            :
            0;

            return `

            <div class="ward-card">

                <h4>
                    ${escapeHTML(ward)}
                </h4>

                <p>
                    Total Beds:
                    <strong>${list.length}</strong>
                </p>

                <p>
                    Occupied:
                    <strong>${occupied}</strong>
                </p>

                <p>
                    Available:
                    <strong>
                        ${
                            list.filter(
                                b=>b.status==="Available"
                            ).length
                        }
                    </strong>
                </p>

                <div class="progress">
                    <div
                        class="progress-bar"
                        style="width:${percent}%"
                    ></div>
                </div>

                <small>
                    Occupancy: ${percent}%
                </small>

            </div>

            `;

        }
    ).join("");

}


function populateFilters(){

    const wardSelect=
    document.getElementById(
        "bedWardFilter"
    );

    const wards=getWards();

    wardSelect.innerHTML=
    `<option value="">
        All Wards
    </option>`+
    wards.map(
        ward=>`
        <option value="${escapeHTML(ward)}">
            ${escapeHTML(ward)}
        </option>
        `
    ).join("");

}


function renderBeds(){

    const tbody=
    document.getElementById(
        "bedTable"
    );

    const query=
    document.getElementById(
        "bedSearch"
    ).value
    .toLowerCase()
    .trim();

    const ward=
    document.getElementById(
        "bedWardFilter"
    ).value;

    const type=
    document.getElementById(
        "bedTypeFilter"
    ).value;

    const status=
    document.getElementById(
        "bedStatusFilter"
    ).value;

    const filtered=
    beds.filter(
        b=>{

            const text=`
                ${b.room}
                ${b.bed}
                ${b.patient}
                ${b.patientId}
                ${b.doctor}
            `.toLowerCase();

            return (
                text.includes(query) &&
                (!ward || b.room===ward) &&
                (!type || b.type===type) &&
                (!status || b.status===status)
            );

        }
    );

    if(filtered.length===0){

        tbody.innerHTML=`
            <tr>
                <td
                    colspan="7"
                    class="empty"
                >
                    No beds found.
                </td>
            </tr>
        `;

        return;
    }

    tbody.innerHTML=
    filtered.map(
        b=>`

        <tr>

            <td>
                ${escapeHTML(b.room)}
            </td>

            <td>
                <strong>
                    ${escapeHTML(b.bed)}
                </strong>
            </td>

            <td>
                ${escapeHTML(b.type)}
            </td>

            <td>
                ${
                    b.patient
                    ?
                    escapeHTML(b.patient)
                    :
                    "—"
                }
            </td>

            <td>
                ${
                    b.doctor
                    ?
                    escapeHTML(b.doctor)
                    :
                    "—"
                }
            </td>

            <td>
                ${statusBadge(b.status)}
            </td>

            <td>

                <button
                    class="btn-blue"
                    onclick="viewBed(${b.id})"
                >
                    View
                </button>

                ${
                    b.status==="Available"
                    ?
                    `
                    <button
                        class="btn-orange"
                        onclick="reserveBed(${b.id})"
                    >
                        Reserve
                    </button>
                    `
                    :
                    ""
                }

                ${
                    b.status==="Reserved"
                    ?
                    `
                    <button
                        class="btn-green"
                        onclick="makeAvailable(${b.id})"
                    >
                        Available
                    </button>
                    `
                    :
                    ""
                }

                ${
                    b.status==="Occupied"
                    ?
                    `
                    <button
                        class="btn-gray"
                        onclick="startCleaning(${b.id})"
                    >
                        Cleaning
                    </button>
                    `
                    :
                    ""
                }

                ${
                    b.status==="Cleaning"
                    ?
                    `
                    <button
                        class="btn-green"
                        onclick="makeAvailable(${b.id})"
                    >
                        Ready
                    </button>
                    `
                    :
                    ""
                }

            </td>

        </tr>

        `
    ).join("");

}


function viewBed(id){

    const bed=
    beds.find(
        b=>b.id===id
    );

    if(!bed)return;

    document.getElementById(
        "bedDetails"
    ).innerHTML=`

        <div class="detail-row">
            <strong>Room</strong>
            <span>${escapeHTML(bed.room)}</span>
        </div>

        <div class="detail-row">
            <strong>Bed Number</strong>
            <span>${escapeHTML(bed.bed)}</span>
        </div>

        <div class="detail-row">
            <strong>Type</strong>
            <span>${escapeHTML(bed.type)}</span>
        </div>

        <div class="detail-row">
            <strong>Status</strong>
            <span>${statusBadge(bed.status)}</span>
        </div>

        <div class="detail-row">
            <strong>Patient</strong>
            <span>${escapeHTML(bed.patient || "Not Assigned")}</span>
        </div>

        <div class="detail-row">
            <strong>Patient ID</strong>
            <span>${escapeHTML(bed.patientId || "—")}</span>
        </div>

        <div class="detail-row">
            <strong>Doctor</strong>
            <span>${escapeHTML(bed.doctor || "Not Assigned")}</span>
        </div>

    `;

    document
    .getElementById("bedModal")
    .classList.add("show");

}


function closeModal(){

    document
    .getElementById("bedModal")
    .classList.remove("show");

}


function addHistory(
    bed,
    action,
    details=""
){

    bedHistory.push({

        date:new Date().toLocaleString(),

        bed:bed.bed,

        room:bed.room,

        action,

        patient:bed.patient || "None",

        details

    });

    saveData();

}


function reserveBed(id){

    const bed=
    beds.find(
        b=>b.id===id
    );

    if(!bed)return;

    if(bed.status!=="Available"){

        alert(
            "Only available beds can be reserved."
        );

        return;
    }

    bed.status="Reserved";

    addHistory(
        bed,
        "Reserved",
        "Bed reserved for patient admission."
    );

    renderAll();

    alert(
        "Bed reserved successfully."
    );

}


function makeAvailable(id){

    const bed=
    beds.find(
        b=>b.id===id
    );

    if(!bed)return;

    bed.status="Available";

    bed.patient="";
    bed.patientId="";
    bed.doctor="";

    addHistory(
        bed,
        "Available",
        "Bed marked available."
    );

    renderAll();

    alert(
        "Bed is now available."
    );

}


function startCleaning(id){

    const bed=
    beds.find(
        b=>b.id===id
    );

    if(!bed)return;

    if(bed.status!=="Occupied"){

        alert(
            "Only occupied beds can be sent for cleaning."
        );

        return;
    }

    const oldPatient=
    bed.patient;

    bed.status="Cleaning";

    bed.patient="";
    bed.patientId="";
    bed.doctor="";

    addHistory(
        bed,
        "Cleaning",
        "Bed released after patient discharge: "+
        oldPatient
    );

    renderAll();

    alert(
        "Bed moved to cleaning status."
    );

}


document
.getElementById("addBedForm")
.addEventListener(
"submit",
function(e){

    e.preventDefault();

    const room=
    document.getElementById(
        "newRoom"
    ).value.trim();

    const bedNumber=
    document.getElementById(
        "newBed"
    ).value.trim();

    const type=
    document.getElementById(
        "newType"
    ).value;

    const status=
    document.getElementById(
        "newStatus"
    ).value;

    if(
        beds.some(
            b=>
                b.bed.toLowerCase()===
                bedNumber.toLowerCase()
        )
    ){

        alert(
            "This bed number already exists."
        );

        return;
    }

    const bed={

        id:
        Date.now(),

        room,

        bed:
        bedNumber,

        type,

        status,

        patient:"",

        patientId:"",

        doctor:""

    };

    beds.push(bed);

    addHistory(
        bed,
        "Created",
        "New bed added to hospital."
    );

    this.reset();

    renderAll();

    alert(
        "New bed added successfully."
    );

});


function renderWards(){

    const box=
    document.getElementById(
        "wardCards"
    );

    const wards=getWards();

    box.innerHTML=
    wards.map(
        ward=>{

            const list=
            beds.filter(
                b=>b.room===ward
            );

            const available=
            list.filter(
                b=>b.status==="Available"
            ).length;

            const occupied=
            list.filter(
                b=>b.status==="Occupied"
            ).length;

            const reserved=
            list.filter(
                b=>b.status==="Reserved"
            ).length;

            const cleaning=
            list.filter(
                b=>b.status==="Cleaning"
            ).length;

            const rate=
            list.length
            ?
            Math.round(
                occupied/list.length*100
            )
            :
            0;

            return `

            <div class="ward-card">

                <h4>
                    ${escapeHTML(ward)}
                </h4>

                <p>
                    Total:
                    <strong>${list.length}</strong>
                </p>

                <p>
                    Available:
                    <strong>${available}</strong>
                </p>

                <p>
                    Occupied:
                    <strong>${occupied}</strong>
                </p>

                <p>
                    Reserved:
                    <strong>${reserved}</strong>
                </p>

                <p>
                    Cleaning:
                    <strong>${cleaning}</strong>
                </p>

                <div class="progress">
                    <div
                        class="progress-bar"
                        style="width:${rate}%"
                    ></div>
                </div>

                <small>
                    Occupancy Rate: ${rate}%
                </small>

            </div>

            `;

        }
    ).join("");

}


function renderOccupancy(){

    const total=beds.length;

    const occupied=
    beds.filter(
        b=>b.status==="Occupied"
    ).length;

    const available=
    beds.filter(
        b=>b.status==="Available"
    ).length;

    const rate=
    total
    ?
    Math.round(
        occupied/total*100
    )
    :
    0;

    document.getElementById(
        "occupancyRate"
    ).textContent=
    rate+"%";

    document.getElementById(
        "occupancyOccupied"
    ).textContent=
    occupied;

    document.getElementById(
        "occupancyAvailable"
    ).textContent=
    available;

    const box=
    document.getElementById(
        "occupancyList"
    );

    const wards=getWards();

    box.innerHTML=
    wards.map(
        ward=>{

            const list=
            beds.filter(
                b=>b.room===ward
            );

            const occupied=
            list.filter(
                b=>b.status==="Occupied"
            ).length;

            const percent=
            list.length
            ?
            Math.round(
                occupied/list.length*100
            )
            :
            0;

            return `

            <div class="ward-card">

                <h4>
                    ${escapeHTML(ward)}
                </h4>

                <div class="progress">

                    <div
                        class="progress-bar"
                        style="width:${percent}%"
                    ></div>

                </div>

                <p>
                    ${occupied}
                    occupied /
                    ${list.length}
                    total
                </p>

            </div>

            `;

        }
    ).join("");

}


function renderEmergency(){

    const emergencyBeds=
    beds.filter(
        b=>
            b.type==="Emergency"
    );

    const available=
    emergencyBeds.filter(
        b=>b.status==="Available"
    ).length;

    const box=
    document.getElementById(
        "emergencyAlert"
    );

    if(available===0){

        box.innerHTML=`
            <div class="alert danger-alert">
                <strong>Emergency Warning:</strong>
                No emergency bed is currently available.
            </div>
        `;

    }else{

        box.innerHTML=`
            <div class="alert success-alert">
                <strong>Emergency Availability:</strong>
                ${available} emergency bed(s) available.
            </div>
        `;

    }

    const tbody=
    document.getElementById(
        "emergencyTable"
    );

    if(emergencyBeds.length===0){

        tbody.innerHTML=`
            <tr>
                <td
                    colspan="5"
                    class="empty"
                >
                    No emergency beds configured.
                </td>
            </tr>
        `;

        return;
    }

    tbody.innerHTML=
    emergencyBeds.map(
        b=>`

        <tr>

            <td>
                ${escapeHTML(b.room)}
            </td>

            <td>
                <strong>
                    ${escapeHTML(b.bed)}
                </strong>
            </td>

            <td>
                ${statusBadge(b.status)}
            </td>

            <td>
                ${escapeHTML(b.patient || "None")}
            </td>

            <td>

                ${
                    b.status==="Available"
                    ?
                    `
                    <button
                        class="btn-orange"
                        onclick="reserveBed(${b.id})"
                    >
                        Reserve
                    </button>
                    `
                    :
                    ""
                }

                <button
                    class="btn-blue"
                    onclick="viewBed(${b.id})"
                >
                    View
                </button>

            </td>

        </tr>

        `
    ).join("");

}


function renderHistory(){

    const tbody=
    document.getElementById(
        "historyTable"
    );

    if(bedHistory.length===0){

        tbody.innerHTML=`
            <tr>
                <td
                    colspan="6"
                    class="empty"
                >
                    No bed history available.
                </td>
            </tr>
        `;

        return;
    }

    tbody.innerHTML=
    [...bedHistory]
    .reverse()
    .map(
        h=>`

        <tr>

            <td>
                ${escapeHTML(h.date)}
            </td>

            <td>
                <strong>
                    ${escapeHTML(h.bed)}
                </strong>
            </td>

            <td>
                ${escapeHTML(h.room)}
            </td>

            <td>
                ${escapeHTML(h.action)}
            </td>

            <td>
                ${escapeHTML(h.patient)}
            </td>

            <td>
                ${escapeHTML(h.details)}
            </td>

        </tr>

        `
    ).join("");

}


function renderAll(){

    populateFilters();

    renderDashboard();

    renderBeds();

    renderWards();

    renderOccupancy();

    renderEmergency();

    renderHistory();

}

<script>

document.documentElement.style.visibility="hidden";

async function verifyAmbulanceAccess(){

    const token=
        localStorage.getItem("gjh_token");

    if(!token){

        window.location.replace("login.html");

        return;
    }

    try{

        const response=
            await fetch(
                "/api/private/ambulance",
                {
                    headers:{
                        "Authorization":
                        "Bearer "+token
                    }
                }
            );

        const data=
            await response.json();

        if(
            !response.ok ||
            !data.success ||
            !data.user ||
            data.user.role!=="ambulance"
        ){

            localStorage.removeItem("gjh_token");
            localStorage.removeItem("gjh_user");

            alert(
                "Access denied. Only authorized ambulance staff can open this panel."
            );

            window.location.replace("login.html");

            return;
        }

        const savedUser=
            JSON.parse(
                localStorage.getItem("gjh_user") || "{}"
            );

        document.addEventListener(
            "DOMContentLoaded",
            ()=>{
                document.getElementById(
                    "staffName"
                ).textContent=
                    savedUser.name ||
                    data.user.name ||
                    "Ambulance Staff";
            }
        );

        document.documentElement.style.visibility="visible";

    }catch(error){

        alert(
            "Unable to verify ambulance login."
        );

        window.location.replace("login.html");

    }

}

verifyAmbulanceAccess();

</script>

let ambulances=
JSON.parse(
    localStorage.getItem(
        "gjh_ambulances"
    ) || "[]"
);

let requests=
JSON.parse(
    localStorage.getItem(
        "gjh_ambulance_requests"
    ) || "[]"
);

let drivers=
JSON.parse(
    localStorage.getItem(
        "gjh_ambulance_drivers"
    ) || "[]"
);

let maintenance=
JSON.parse(
    localStorage.getItem(
        "gjh_ambulance_maintenance"
    ) || "[]"
);

let tripHistory=
JSON.parse(
    localStorage.getItem(
        "gjh_ambulance_history"
    ) || "[]"
);


function saveData(){

    localStorage.setItem(
        "gjh_ambulances",
        JSON.stringify(ambulances)
    );

    localStorage.setItem(
        "gjh_ambulance_requests",
        JSON.stringify(requests)
    );

    localStorage.setItem(
        "gjh_ambulance_drivers",
        JSON.stringify(drivers)
    );

    localStorage.setItem(
        "gjh_ambulance_maintenance",
        JSON.stringify(maintenance)
    );

    localStorage.setItem(
        "gjh_ambulance_history",
        JSON.stringify(tripHistory)
    );

}


function escapeHTML(value){

    return String(value ?? "")
    .replace(/&/g,"&amp;")
    .replace(/</g,"&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g,"&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g,"&quot;")
    .replace(/'/g,"&#039;");

}

function statusBadge(status){

    let cls="available";

    if(status==="Busy"){
        cls="busy";
    }

    if(status==="En Route"){
        cls="enroute";
    }

    if(status==="Maintenance"){
        cls="maintenance";
    }

    if(status==="Offline"){
        cls="offline";
    }

    if(status==="Pending"){
        cls="pending";
    }

    if(status==="Completed"){
        cls="completed";
    }

    return `
        <span class="badge ${cls}">
            ${escapeHTML(status)}
        </span>
    `;

}


function showPage(id,link){

    document
    .querySelectorAll(".page")
    .forEach(
        p=>p.classList.remove("active")
    );

    document
    .querySelectorAll(".sidebar a")
    .forEach(
        a=>a.classList.remove("active")
    );

    document
    .getElementById(id)
    .classList.add("active");

    link.classList.add("active");

    if(id==="dashboard"){
        renderDashboard();
    }

    if(id==="ambulances"){
        renderAmbulances();
    }

    if(id==="requests"){
        renderRequests();
    }

    if(id==="dispatch"){
        renderDispatch();
    }

    if(id==="drivers"){
        renderDrivers();
    }

    if(id==="maintenance"){
        populateMaintenanceAmbulances();
        renderMaintenance();
    }

    if(id==="history"){
        renderHistory();
    }

}


function renderDashboard(){

    const total=ambulances.length;

    const available=
        ambulances.filter(
            a=>a.status==="Available"
        ).length;

    const enroute=
        ambulances.filter(
            a=>a.status==="En Route"
        ).length;

    const busy=
        ambulances.filter(
            a=>a.status==="Busy"
        ).length;

    const pending=
        requests.filter(
            r=>r.status==="Pending"
        ).length;

    document.getElementById(
        "totalAmbulances"
    ).textContent=total;

    document.getElementById(
        "availableAmbulances"
    ).textContent=available;

    document.getElementById(
        "enrouteAmbulances"
    ).textContent=enroute;

    document.getElementById(
        "busyAmbulances"
    ).textContent=busy;

    document.getElementById(
        "pendingRequests"
    ).textContent=pending;


    const alerts=[];


    if(pending>0){

        alerts.push(`
            <div class="alert danger-alert">
                <strong>Emergency:</strong>
                ${pending} pending ambulance request(s) require attention.
            </div>
        `);

    }


    if(available===0){

        alerts.push(`
            <div class="alert danger-alert">
                <strong>Critical:</strong>
                No ambulance is currently available.
            </div>
        `);

    }


    if(available>0){

        alerts.push(`
            <div class="alert success-alert">
                <strong>Available:</strong>
                ${available} ambulance(s) ready for dispatch.
            </div>
        `);

    }


    if(alerts.length===0){

        alerts.push(`
            <div class="alert info-alert">
                Ambulance operations are normal.
            </div>
        `);

    }


    document.getElementById(
        "dashboardAlerts"
    ).innerHTML=
        alerts.join("");


    const fleet=
        document.getElementById(
            "dashboardFleet"
        );

    fleet.innerHTML=
        ambulances.map(
            a=>`

            <div class="ambulance-card">

                <div class="ambulance-icon">
                    🚑
                </div>

                <h4>
                    ${escapeHTML(a.number)}
                </h4>

                <p>
                    ${escapeHTML(a.type)}
                </p>

                <p>
                    Driver:
                    ${escapeHTML(a.driver)}
                </p>

                <p>
                    Location:
                    ${escapeHTML(a.location)}
                </p>

                <br>

                ${statusBadge(a.status)}

            </div>

            `
        ).join("");

}


function populateAmbulanceFilters(){

    const type=
        document.getElementById(
            "ambulanceTypeFilter"
        );

}


function renderAmbulances(){

    const query=
        document.getElementById(
            "ambulanceSearch"
        ).value
        .toLowerCase()
        .trim();

    const type=
        document.getElementById(
            "ambulanceTypeFilter"
        ).value;

    const status=
        document.getElementById(
            "ambulanceStatusFilter"
        ).value;

    const filtered=
        ambulances.filter(
            a=>{

                const text=`
                    ${a.number}
                    ${a.type}
                    ${a.driver}
                    ${a.location}
                `.toLowerCase();

                return(
                    text.includes(query) &&
                    (!type || a.type===type) &&
                    (!status || a.status===status)
                );

            }
        );


    const tbody=
        document.getElementById(
            "ambulanceTable"
        );


    if(filtered.length===0){

        tbody.innerHTML=`
            <tr>
                <td
                    colspan="6"
                    class="empty"
                >
                    No ambulances found.
                </td>
            </tr>
        `;

        return;

    }


    tbody.innerHTML=
        filtered.map(
            a=>`

            <tr>

                <td>
                    <strong>
                        ${escapeHTML(a.number)}
                    </strong>
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(a.type)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(a.driver)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(a.location)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${statusBadge(a.status)}
                </td>

                <td>

                    <button
                        class="btn-blue"
                        onclick="viewAmbulance(${a.id})"
                    >
                        View
                    </button>

                    ${
                        a.status==="Available"
                        ?
                        `
                        <button
                            class="btn-orange"
                            onclick="setEnRoute(${a.id})"
                        >
                            Dispatch
                        </button>
                        `
                        :
                        ""
                    }

                    ${
                        a.status==="Maintenance"
                        ?
                        `
                        <button
                            class="btn-green"
                            onclick="setAvailable(${a.id})"
                        >
                            Ready
                        </button>
                        `
                        :
                        ""
                    }

                </td>

            </tr>

            `
        ).join("");

}


function viewAmbulance(id){

    const a=
        ambulances.find(
            item=>item.id===id
        );

    if(!a)return;

    document.getElementById(
        "ambulanceDetails"
    ).innerHTML=`

        <div class="detail-row">
            <strong>Ambulance</strong>
            <span>${escapeHTML(a.number)}</span>
        </div>

        <div class="detail-row">
            <strong>Type</strong>
            <span>${escapeHTML(a.type)}</span>
        </div>

        <div class="detail-row">
            <strong>Driver</strong>
            <span>${escapeHTML(a.driver)}</span>
        </div>

        <div class="detail-row">
            <strong>Location</strong>
            <span>${escapeHTML(a.location)}</span>
        </div>

        <div class="detail-row">
            <strong>Status</strong>
            <span>${statusBadge(a.status)}</span>
        </div>

    `;

    document
    .getElementById("ambulanceModal")
    .classList.add("show");

}


function closeModal(){

    document
    .getElementById("ambulanceModal")
    .classList.remove("show");

}


function setEnRoute(id){

    const a=
        ambulances.find(
            item=>item.id===id
        );

    if(!a)return;

    if(a.status!=="Available"){

        alert(
            "Only available ambulances can be dispatched."
        );

        return;

    }

    a.status="En Route";

    saveData();

    renderAll();

    alert(
        a.number+
        " has been dispatched."
    );

}


function setAvailable(id){

    const a=
        ambulances.find(
            item=>item.id===id
        );

    if(!a)return;

    a.status="Available";

    saveData();

    renderAll();

    alert(
        a.number+
        " is now available."
    );

}


document
.getElementById("requestForm")
.addEventListener(
"submit",
function(e){

    e.preventDefault();

    const request={

        id:Date.now(),

        patient:
            document.getElementById(
                "requestPatient"
            ).value.trim(),

        phone:
            document.getElementById(
                "requestPhone"
            ).value.trim(),

        pickup:
            document.getElementById(
                "pickupLocation"
            ).value.trim(),

        destination:
            document.getElementById(
                "destination"
            ).value.trim(),

        priority:
            document.getElementById(
                "requestPriority"
            ).value,

        type:
            document.getElementById(
                "requestType"
            ).value,

        status:"Pending",

        ambulance:"",

        driver:"",

        createdAt:
            new Date().toLocaleString()

    };

    requests.push(request);

    saveData();

    this.reset();

    renderAll();

    alert(
        "Emergency ambulance request created."
    );

});


function renderRequests(){

    const tbody=
        document.getElementById(
            "requestTable"
        );

    if(requests.length===0){

        tbody.innerHTML=`
            <tr>
                <td
                    colspan="6"
                    class="empty"
                >
                    No emergency requests yet.
                </td>
            </tr>
        `;

        return;

    }


    tbody.innerHTML=
        [...requests]
        .reverse()
        .map(
            r=>`

            <tr>

                <td>
                    <strong>
                        ${escapeHTML(r.patient)}
                    </strong>
                    <br>
                    <small>
                        ${escapeHTML(r.phone)}
                    </small>
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(r.pickup)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(r.destination)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    <strong>
                        ${escapeHTML(r.priority)}
                    </strong>
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${statusBadge(r.status)}
                </td>

                <td>

                    ${
                        r.status==="Pending"
                        ?
                        `
                        <button
                            class="btn-blue"
                            onclick="openDispatch(${r.id})"
                        >
                            Dispatch
                        </button>
                        `
                        :
                        ""
                    }

                    ${
                        r.status==="Dispatched"
                        ?
                        `
                        <button
                            class="btn-green"
                            onclick="completeRequest(${r.id})"
                        >
                            Complete
                        </button>
                        `
                        :
                        ""
                    }

                </td>

            </tr>

            `
        ).join("");

}


function renderDispatch(){

    const box=
        document.getElementById(
            "dispatchList"
        );

    const pending=
        requests.filter(
            r=>r.status==="Pending"
        );

    if(pending.length===0){

        box.innerHTML=`
            <div class="alert success-alert">
                No pending emergency requests.
            </div>
        `;

        return;

    }


    box.innerHTML=
        pending.map(
            r=>`

            <div class="ambulance-card">

                <h4>
                    Emergency Request
                </h4>

                <p>
                    <strong>Patient:</strong>
                    ${escapeHTML(r.patient)}
                </p>

                <p>
                    <strong>Pickup:</strong>
                    ${escapeHTML(r.pickup)}
                </p>

                <p>
                    <strong>Destination:</strong>
                    ${escapeHTML(r.destination)}
                </p>

                <p>
                    <strong>Priority:</strong>
                    ${escapeHTML(r.priority)}
                </p>

                <br>

                <button
                    class="btn-red"
                    onclick="openDispatch(${r.id})"
                >
                    Dispatch Ambulance
                </button>

            </div>

            <br>

            `
        ).join("");

}


function openDispatch(requestId){

    const request=
        requests.find(
            r=>r.id===requestId
        );

    if(!request)return;

    const available=
        ambulances.filter(
            a=>
                a.status==="Available" &&
                (
                    !request.type ||
                    a.type===request.type
                )
        );

    if(available.length===0){

        alert(
            "No matching ambulance is currently available."
        );

        return;

    }


    let choices=
        available
        .map(
            a=>
                `${a.id}: ${a.number} - ${a.type} - Driver: ${a.driver}`
        )
        .join("\n");


    const selected=
        prompt(
            "Enter ambulance ID to dispatch:\n\n"+
            choices
        );


    if(!selected)return;

    const id=
        Number(selected);

    const ambulance=
        available.find(
            a=>a.id===id
        );

    if(!ambulance){

        alert(
            "Invalid ambulance ID."
        );

        return;

    }


    ambulance.status="En Route";

    ambulance.location=
        request.pickup;


    request.status="Dispatched";

    request.ambulance=
        ambulance.number;

    request.driver=
        ambulance.driver;

    saveData();

    renderAll();

    alert(
        ambulance.number+
        " dispatched successfully."
    );

}


function completeRequest(requestId){

    const request=
        requests.find(
            r=>r.id===requestId
        );

    if(!request)return;

    const ambulance=
        ambulances.find(
            a=>a.number===request.ambulance
        );

    if(ambulance){

        ambulance.status="Available";

        ambulance.location=
            "Hospital Campus";

    }


    request.status="Completed";

    tripHistory.push({

        date:
            new Date().toLocaleString(),

        patient:
            request.patient,

        ambulance:
            request.ambulance,

        driver:
            request.driver,

        pickup:
            request.pickup,

        destination:
            request.destination

    });

    saveData();

    renderAll();

    alert(
        "Ambulance trip completed."
    );

}


function renderDrivers(){

    const tbody=
        document.getElementById(
            "driverTable"
        );

    if(drivers.length===0){

        tbody.innerHTML=`
            <tr>
                <td
                    colspan="6"
                    class="empty"
                >
                    No drivers available.
                </td>
            </tr>
        `;

        return;

    }


    tbody.innerHTML=
        drivers.map(
            d=>`

            <tr>

                <td>
                    <strong>
                        ${escapeHTML(d.name)}
                    </strong>
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(d.license)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(d.phone)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(d.ambulance)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(d.shift)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${statusBadge(
                        d.status==="On Duty"
                        ?
                        "En Route"
                        :
                        d.status
                    )}
                </td>

            </tr>

            `
        ).join("");

}


function populateMaintenanceAmbulances(){

    const select=
        document.getElementById(
            "maintenanceAmbulance"
        );

    select.innerHTML=
        ambulances.map(
            a=>`

            <option value="${a.id}">
                ${escapeHTML(a.number)}
            </option>

            `
        ).join("");

}


function addMaintenance(){

    const id=
        Number(
            document.getElementById(
                "maintenanceAmbulance"
            ).value
        );

    const ambulance=
        ambulances.find(
            a=>a.id===id
        );

    if(!ambulance)return;

    const record={

        date:
            document.getElementById(
                "maintenanceDate"
            ).value ||
            new Date()
            .toISOString()
            .split("T")[0],

        ambulance:
            ambulance.number,

        type:
            document.getElementById(
                "maintenanceType"
            ).value,

        notes:
            document.getElementById(
                "maintenanceNotes"
            ).value.trim()

    };

    maintenance.push(record);

    ambulance.status="Maintenance";

    saveData();

    document.getElementById(
        "maintenanceNotes"
    ).value="";

    renderAll();

    alert(
        "Maintenance record added."
    );

}


function renderMaintenance(){

    const tbody=
        document.getElementById(
            "maintenanceTable"
        );

    if(maintenance.length===0){

        tbody.innerHTML=`
            <tr>
                <td
                    colspan="4"
                    class="empty"
                >
                    No maintenance records yet.
                </td>
            </tr>
        `;

        return;

    }


    tbody.innerHTML=
        [...maintenance]
        .reverse()
        .map(
            m=>`

            <tr>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(m.date)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(m.ambulance)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(m.type)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(m.notes || "—")}
                </td>

            </tr>

            `
        ).join("");

}


function renderHistory(){

    const tbody=
        document.getElementById(
            "historyTable"
        );

    if(tripHistory.length===0){

        tbody.innerHTML=`
            <tr>
                <td
                    colspan="6"
                    class="empty"
                >
                    No completed trips yet.
                </td>
            </tr>
        `;

        return;

    }


    tbody.innerHTML=
        [...tripHistory]
        .reverse()
        .map(
            h=>`

            <tr>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(h.date)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(h.patient)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(h.ambulance)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(h.driver)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(h.pickup)}
                </td>

                <td>
                    ${escapeHTML(h.destination)}
                </td>

            </tr>

            `
        ).join("");

}


function renderAll(){

    populateMaintenanceAmbulances();

    renderDashboard();

    renderAmbulances();

    renderRequests();

    renderDispatch();

    renderDrivers();

    renderMaintenance();

    renderHistory();

}


document
.getElementById("ambulanceSearch")
.addEventListener(
    "input",
    renderAmbulances
);

document
.getElementById("ambulanceTypeFilter")
.addEventListener(
    "change",
    renderAmbulances
);

document
.getElementById("ambulanceStatusFilter")
.addEventListener(
    "change",
    renderAmbulances
);


function logout(){

    localStorage.removeItem(
        "gjh_token"
    );

    localStorage.removeItem(
        "gjh_user"
    );

    window.location.replace(
        "login.html"
    );

}


createDemoData();

renderAll();
